we will pick some of the flowers
and give them as a present to our friends.

zh: 看着友人拿走自己的劳动果实，心里自然特别喜欢。
en:
We are of course especially happy to
see them take away our fruits of labour.

zh: 当然，也有伤心的时候，今年夏天这有这么一回。三百株菊秧还在地上，下了暴雨。
en:
Of course, there is a time to feel sad too.
Last summer, a rainstorm hit us
when 300 chrysanthemum
seedlings in the courtyard
were about to be transplanted to pots.

zh: 邻家的墙倒了下来，(+并且）菊秧被砸死者约三十多种，一百多棵！全家都几天没有笑容！
en:
Suddenly, the wall of our neighbour collapsed
and crushed more than 100 seedlings of 30 varieties.
The whole family were sad-faced
for quite a few days!

zh: 有喜有忧，有笑有泪，有花有实，有香有色，既须劳动，又长见识，这就是养花的乐趣。
en:
Joy and sorrow, laughter and tears,
flowers and fruit, fragrance and colour,
manual labour and increased knowledge
——all these make up
the joy of flower cultivation.

zh: 有这样一个故事。
en: There is a story which goes like this:

zh: 有人问：世界上什么东西的气力最大？
en:
Someone asked,
"What has the greatest strength on earth?"

zh: 回答纷绘的很，
en: The answers varied.

zh: 有的说“象”，有的说“狮”，
en:
Some said," The elephant."
Some said," The lion."

zh: 有人开玩笑似的说：是“金刚”，金刚有多少气力，当然大家全不知道。
en:
Some said jokingly,
"The fierce-browed guardian gods to Buddha."
But nobody of course could tell
how strong the guardian gods
were supposed to be.

zh: 结果，这一切答案完全不对，世界上气力最大的，是植物的种子。
en:
All the answers turned out
to be wide of the mark.
The mightiest thing on earth
is the seed of a plant.

zh: 一粒种子所可以显现出来的力，简直是超越一切，这儿又是一个故事。
en:
The great strength
which a seed is capable of
is simply matchless.
Here goes another story:

zh: 人的头盖骨，结合得非常致密与坚固，生理学家和解剖学者用尽了一切的方法，要把它完整在分出来，都没有这种力气，
en:
The bones forming a human skull
are so tightly and perfectly fit together
that all physiologists or anatomists,
hard as they try.
are powerless to take them apart
without damaging them.

zh: 后来忽然有人发明了一个方法，就是把植物的种子放在要解剖的头盖骨里，给它以温度与湿度，使它发芽，
en:
It so happened that,
at the suggestion of someone,
some seeds of plant
were placed inside
a human skull awaiting dissection
before heat and moisture
were applied to cause them to grow.

zh:
一发芽，这些种子便以可怕的力量，
将一切机械力所不能分开的骨骼，完整地分开了。
en:
Once they started to grow,
they let loose a terrific force
to separate all the skull bones,
leaving each of them intact.
This would have been impossible
with any mechanical power under the sun.

zh: 植物种子力量之大，如此如此。
en: See, how powerful the seeds of a plant can be!

zh: 这，也许特殊了一点，常人不容易理解，
en:
This story may be somewhat
too unusual for you to understand.

zh: 那么，你看见笋的成长吗？
en:
Well, have you ever seen
the growth of a bamboo shoot?

zh: 你看见被压在瓦砾和石块下面的一颗小草的生成吗？
en:
Or the growth of tender grass
from under a heap of rubble or rocks?

zh:
它为着向往阳光，为着达成它的生之意志，
不管上面的石块如何重，石块与石块之间如何狭，它必定要曲曲折折地，但是顽强不屈地透到地面上来，
en:
Seeking sunlight and survival,
the young plant will labour tenaciously
through twists and turns
to bring itself to the surface of the ground
no matter how heavy the rocks overhead may be
or how narrow the opening between them.

zh: 它的根往土壤里钻，它的芽往地面挺，
en:
While striking its roots deep into the soil,
the young plant pushes
its new shoots above-ground.

zh: 这是一种不可抗拒的力，阻止它的石块，结果也被它掀翻，
en:
The irresistible strength it can muster is
such as to overturn any rock in its way.

zh: 一粒种子的力量的大，如此如此。
en: See, how powerful a seed can be!

zh: 没有一个人将小草叫做“大力士”，但是它的力量之大，的确是世界无比，
en:
Though nobody describes
the little grass as a"husky",
yet its herculean strength
is unrivalled.

zh: 这种力，是一般人看不见的生命力，
en: It is the force of life invisible to the naked eye.

zh: 上面的石块，丝毫不足以阻挡，因为它是一种“长期抗战”的力，有弹性，能屈能伸的力，有韧性，不达目的不止的力。
en:
The rock is utterly helpless before this force
——a force that will forever remain militant,
a force that is resilient
and can take temporary set backs calmly,
a force that is tenacity itself
and will never give up until the goal is reached.

zh: 种子不落在肥土而落在瓦砾中，有生命力的种子决不会悲观和叹气，因为有阻力才有磨炼。
en:
When a seed falls under debris
instead of on fertile soil,
it never sighs in despair
because to meet with obstruction
means to temper itself.

zh: 生命开始的一瞬间就带了斗争来的草，才是坚韧的草，也只有这种草，才可以傲然地对那些玻璃棚中养育着的盆花哄笑。
en:
Indomitable is the grass
that begins its very life with a tough struggle.
It is only fit and proper
that the proud grass should be
jeering at the potted flowers in a glass house.

zh: 前些日子，林语堂先生似乎曾说过女子的唯一事业，是在结婚，
en:
The other day,
Mr. Lin Yutang said something to the effect that women's only career lies in matrimony.

zh: 现在一位法国大文豪来沪，对去访问他的新闻记者的谈话之中，又似乎说，男子欲成事业，应该不要结婚。
en:
Now, an eminent French writer
declared at a press interview
after arriving in Shanghai
that men should stay bachelors
if they want to achieve success in life.

zh:
华盛顿.欧文是一个独身的男子，
但《见闻短记》里的一篇歌颂妻子的文章，却写的那么优美可爱。
en:
Washington Irving was a confirmed bachelor,
but in his Sketch Book
there is an article extolling the wife as
a graceful and lovely life-long partner.

zh: 同样查而斯·兰姆也是独身的男子，而爱丽亚的《独身者的不平》一篇，
en:
Charles Lamb, also a single man,
in A Bachelor's Complaint of
the Behaviour of Married People,
one of his essays signed "Elia",

zh: 又冷嘲热讽，将结婚的男女和婚后必然的果子一小孩们一等，俏皮到了那一步田地。
en:
speaks mockingly of married people
with their inevitable postnuptial fruits
——the children.

zh: 究竟是结婚的好呢，还是不结婚的好？
en:
Marriage or no marriage,
which is more desirable?

zh: 这问题似乎同先有鸡还是先有鸡蛋一样，常常有人提起，而也常常没有人解决过的问题。
en:
That sounds like
the chicken-and-egg question,
which, though often discussed,
remains a perpetual puzzle.

zh: 照大体看来（=总的来说）,想租房子的时候，是无眷莫问的，
en:
Generally speaking,
one who has no family dependants
is not supposed to rent a house.

zh: 想做官的时候，又是朝里无裙莫做官的，想写文章的时候，是独身者不能写我的妻的，凡此种种似乎都是结婚的好。
en:
one who has no petticoat influence in the government
should refrain from becoming an official,
an unmarried male writer
is in no position to writer about "my wife".
All these seem to hint at the advantage of marriage.

zh: 可是要想结婚，第一要有钱，第二要有闲，第三要有职，这潘驴……的五个条件，却也不容易办到。
en:
But, to get married,
you need to have five perquisites,
namely, money, leisure, employment,
good looks and potentness,
of which all are not always available.

zh: 更何况结婚之后，“儿子自己要来”，
en:
What is more,
after your marriage,
your offspring
will come to this world of themselves.

zh: 在这世界人口过剩，经济恐慌，教育破产，世风不古的时候，
en:
And in a world with overpopulation,
economic crisis, educational bankruptcy
and deteriorating public morals,

zh: 万一不慎，同兰姆所说的一样，儿子们去上了断头台，
en:
they may, just as Charles Lamb says,
through their own acts of indiscretion,
be sent to the gallows.

zh: 那真是连祖宗三代的帽都要倒尽，那里还有什么“官人请！娘子请！”的唱随之乐可说呢？
en:
With such a terrible misfortune
befalling your family,
how could you still have
wedded bliss to speak of?

zh: 左思右想，总觉得结婚也不好的，不结婚也是不好的。
en:
Thinking the matter over and over again,
I cannot but come to the conclusion that
neither matrimony nor bachelorship
has anything to recommend itself.

zh: 前后加起来，我在北京已经住了四十多年，算是一个老北京了。
en:
I've been in Beijing
altogether for over 40years.
So I can well call myself
a long-timer of Beijing.

zh: 北京的名胜古迹，北京的妙处，我应该说是了解的；其他老北京当然也了解。
en:
Like all other long-timers of the city,
I'm supposed to be very familiar
with its scenic spots and historical sites,
nay, its superb attractions.

zh: 但是有一点，我相信绝大多数老北京并不了解，这就是黎明时分以前的北京。
en:
But I believe there is one thing lying unknown
to most of the long-time residents
-the predawn hours of Beijing.

zh:
多少年来，我养成了一个习惯：
每天早晨四点在黎明以前起床工作。
en:
For many years,
I have been in the habit of
getting up before daybreak
to start work at four.

zh: 我不出去跑步或散步，而是一下床就干活儿。
en:
Instead of going out for a jog or walk,
I'll set about my work as soon as I'm out of bed.

zh: 因此我对黎明前的北京的了解，是在屋子里感觉到的。
en:
As a result,
it is from inside my study
that I've got the feel of predawn Beijing.

zh:
我从前在什么报上读过一篇文章，
讲黎明时分天安门广场上的清洁工人。
en:
Years ago, I hit upon
a newspaper article about
street cleaner in Tian'anmen Square
at daybreak.

zh: 那情景必然是非常动人的，可惜我从未能见到，只是心向往之而已。
en:
It must have been
a very moving scene,
but what a pity
I haven't seen it with my own eyes.
I can only picture it
in my mind longingly.

zh: 四十年前，我住在城里在明朝曾经是特务机关的东厂里面。
en:
Forty years ago,
I lived downtown in Dongchang,
a compound which had housed
the secret service of the Ming dynasty.

zh: 几座深深的大院子，在最里面三个院子里只住着我一个人。
en:
There were inside it
several deep spacious courtyard
one leading into another.
I was the sole dweller
of the three innermost courtyards.

zh: 朋友们都说这地方阴森可怕，晚上很少有人敢来找我，我则怡然自得。
en:
My friends,
calling this place too ghastly,
seldom dared to come to see me in the evening
whereas I myself found it quite agreeable.

zh: 每当夏夜，我起床以后，立刻就闻到院子里那些高大的马绥花树散发出来的阵阵幽香，这些香气破窗而入，
en:
In summer,
the moment I got out of bed
before daybreak,
I would smell
the delicate fragrance
of the giant silk trees.
coming from outside my window.

zh: 我于此时神清气爽，乐不可支，连手中那一枝笨拙的笔也仿佛生了花。
en:
Thereupon,
I would feel refreshed and joyful,
and the clumsy pen in my hand
would seem to have become
as agile as it could.

zh: 几年以后，我搬到西郊来住，照例四点起床，坐在窗前工作。
en:
Several years later
when I moved to the western suburbs,
I kept my habit of rising at four
to begin work at the window.

zh: 白天透过窗子能够看到北京展览馆那金光闪闪的高塔的尖顶，此时当然看不到了。
en:
The glittering spire a top the tower
of the daytime through my window,
would no longer be visible now
in the early morning haze.

zh: 但是，我知道，即使我看不见它，它仍然在那里挺然耸入天空，仿佛想带给人以希望，以上进的劲头。
en:
Nevertheless I knew that,
tough invisible, it remained there intact,
towering to the skies to inspire people
with hope and the urge for moving ahead.

zh: 我仍然是乐不可支，心也仿佛飞上了高空。
en:
At this, I would be
beside myself with joy
and feel as if my heart were also
flying high up into the skies.

zh: 过了十年，我又搬了家。
en:
Ten years after,
I moved again.

zh: 这新居既没有马缕花，也看不到金色的塔顶。
en:
In the new home of mine,
I had no silk trees,
nor could I get sight of
the glittering spire from afar.

zh: 但是门前却有一片清碧的荷塘。
en:
There was, however,
a lotus pond of limpid blue
in front of my door.

zh: 刚搬来的几年，池塘里还有荷花。
en:
In the first few years
after I moved there,
lotus flowers continued to blossom
on the surface of the pond.

zh:
夏天早晨四点已经算是黎明时分。
在薄暗中透过窗子可以看到接天莲叶，而荷花的香气也幽然袭来，我顾而乐之，大有超出马缕花和金色塔顶之上的意味了。
en:
In the summer time,
when day broke early at four,
a vast stretch of lotus leaves
looking skywards outside my window
came dimly into sight
while the quiet fragrance of the lotus flowers
assailed my nose.
All that delighted me
even more than the silk trees
and the glittering spire.

zh: 难道我欣赏黎明前的北京仅仅由于上述的原因吗？不是的。
en:
Is it exclusively due to
the above-mentioned
that I've developed a liking for
predawn Beijing? No.

zh: 三十几年以来，我成了一个“开会迷”。
en:
For 30 years,
I've been bogged down
in the mire of meetings.

zh: 说老实话，积三十年之经验，我真有点怕开会了。
en:
To tell you the truth,
with the experience accumulated
over the 30 years,
I'm now scared of meetings.

zh: 说一句过火的话，我简直是提心吊胆，心里不得安宁。
en:
To exaggerate it a bit,
that keeps me in constant suspense
and makes me fidgety.

zh: 即使不开会，这种喘喘不安的心情总摆脱不掉。
en:
Even when no meeting is to take place,
I feel restless all the same.

zh: 只有在黎明以前，根据我的经验，没有哪里会来找你开会的。
en:
However, my experience tells
that it is only during the predawn hours
that I can be truly havened
from any involvement in meetings.

zh: 因此，我起床往桌子旁边一坐，仿佛有什么近似条件反射的东西立刻就起了作用，我心里安安静静，一下子进入角色，拿起笔来，
en:
As soon as I sit at my desk before dawn,
something similar to the conditioned reflex
will begin to function within me:
Instantly I'll pick up my pen
to play my proper part
with perfect peace of mind.

zh: “文思”（如果也算是文思的话）如泉水喷涌，记忆力也像刚磨过的刀子，锐不可当。
en:
Then inspiration comes gushing to my mind
and my memory becomes as quick as
a newly-sharpened knife.

zh: 当时，我真乐不可支，如果给我机会的话，我简直想手舞足蹈了。
en:
I'll feel overjoyed,
almost to the point of
waving my arms and stamping my feet.

zh: 因此，我爱北京，特别爱黎明前的北京。
en:
In short, I love Beijing,
especially predawn Beijing.

zh: 也许是我的精、气、神都不足吧，不但自己写不出长的东西，我读一本刊物时，也总是先挑短的看，不论是小说、散文或是其他的文学形式，最后才看长的。
en:
Perhaps due to my failing energies,
not only have I
refrained from writing anything long,
but also, in reading a magazine,
for example,
I usually finish its shorter pieces of writing first,
be they fiction, prose
or any other forms of literature
before going on to the longer ones.

zh: 我总觉得，凡是为了非倾吐不可而写的作品，都是充满了真情实感的。
en:
I always believe that anything
written with an irresistible inner urge
to unbosom oneself
must be full of genuine feelings.

zh: 反之，只是为写作而写作，如上之为应付编辑朋友，一之为多拿稿费，这类文章大都是尽量地往长里写，结果是即便的一点点的感情，也被冲洗到水分太多、淡而无味的地步。
en:
On the contrary,
if one writes simply for
the sake of writing-say,
to humour one's editor friends,
or worse still,
to earn more remuneration,
one will most probably
make his writings unnecessarily long
until they become,
despite what little feeling they may contain,
inflated and wishy-washy.

zh: 当由一个人物，一桩事迹，一幅画面而发生的真情实感，向你袭来的时候，它就像一根扎到你心尖上的长针，一阵卷到你面前的怒潮，你只能用最真切、最简练的文字，才能描画出你心尖上的那一阵剧痛和你面前的那一霎惊惶！
en:
When true emotions aroused by a person,
an event or a scene come upon you
like a pin pricking your heart
or an angry tide surging threateningly before you,
all you can do is
use the most vivid and succinct language
to describe the severe pain in your heart
or the momentary feeling of panic
caused by the angry tide.

zh: 我们伟大的祖国，是有写短文的文学传统的。
en:
Our great motherland
is known for its literary tradition of short essays.

zh: 那部包括上下数千年的《古文观止》，“上起东周，下迄明末，共选辑（=选择编辑=共录入）文章220篇”有几篇是长的？
en:
Do you find anything unduely long
in A Treasury of Best Ancient Chinese Prose
with its 220 essays selected from
a period of several thousand years in ancient China
from the Eastern Zhou Dynasty
down until the end of the Ming Dynasty?

zh:
如杜牧的《阿房宫赋》，韩愈的《祭十二郎文》等等，哪一篇不是短而充满了真情实感？
今人的巴金的《随感录》，不也是一个实例吗？
en:
Aren't the essays in it,
like Du Mu's Rhapsody on Epang Palace
and Han Yu's
An Elegiac Address to My Nephew Shi'erlang,
all short and yet full of true feelings?
Isn't A Collection of Random Thoughts by Ba Jin,
our contemporary,
another like example of pithy writing?

zh: 读最近一期的《文学评论》，
en:
In the latest issue of
the Literary Review,

zh: 里面有几篇关于“红学”的文章，引起了我的注意。
en:
several articles on Redology
have attracted my attention.

zh:
有的作者既反省，又批判。
有的作者从困境中找出路。
有的作者慨叹，“红学”出了危机。

如此等等，煞是热闹。
文章的论点都非常精彩，很有启发。
en:
and so on and so forth.
The discussion is quite animated.
The arguments set forth in articles
are very interesting and enlightening.

zh: 但是，我却忽然想到了一个怪问题：这样的“红学”有用处吗？
en:
Nevertheless,
a strange question has occurred to me:
Is this kind of Redology
of any use at all?

zh: 对红学家本身，对在大学里和研究所里从事文学理论研究的人，当然有用。
en:
It is of course useful
to the Redologists themselves
as well as to those
engaged in the study of literary theory
at universities and research institutes.

zh: 但是对广大的《红楼梦》的读者呢？我看是没有用处。
en:
But, to my mind,
it is of little use
to readers of A Dream of Red Mansions
at large.

zh: 《红楼梦》问世二百年以来，通过汉文原文和各种译文读过本书的人，无虑多少个亿。
en:
Ever since
the publication of this novel
some 200 years ago,
hundreds of millions of people
have read its Chinese original
or its translations in various languages.

zh:
这样多的读者哪一个是先看批评家的文章，
然后再让批评家牵着鼻子走，按图索翼地去读原作呢？我看是绝无仅有。
en:
Of these innumerable people,
how many have read the novel
by starting with
a perusal of critics' articles
and allowing themselves
to be led by the nose by the critics
as to how to read the novel?
Next to none.

zh: 一切文学作品，特别是像《红楼梦》这样伟大的作品，内容异常地丰富，涉及到的社会层面异常地多，简直像是一个宝山，一座迷宫。
en:
All literary works,
especially a monumental one
like A Dream of Red Mansions,
are extremely rich in content
and involve diverse social strata
- to such an extent that
they virtually resemble
a mountain of treasure or a labyrinth.

zh: 而读者群就更为复杂，不同的家庭背景，不同的社会经历，不同的民族，不同的国家，不同的文化传统，不同的心理素质，不同的年龄，不同的性别，不同的职业，不同的爱好
en:
And the readers
are even more complicated,
differing from each other
in family background, social experience,
nationality, country, cultural tradition,
psychological condition, age, sex,
profession, hobby, etc., etc.

zh: 还可以这样“不同”下去，就此打住——，
en:
The list could go on endlessly,
so I wouldn't mind stopping here.

zh: 他们来读《红楼梦》，会各就自己的特点，欣赏《红楼梦》中的某一个方面，
en:
They will each appreciate
a certain aspect of the novel
according to their own individuality.

zh: 受到鼓舞，受到启发，引起了喜爱；也可能受到打击，引起了憎恶，总之是千差万别。
en:
They may feel
inspired and enlightened,
and hence love it,
or they may feel hurt,
and hence loathe it.
In short, the reactions vary.

zh: 对这此读者来说，“红学家”就好像是住在“太虚幻境”里的圣人、贤人，与自己无关。
en:
To. them,
the Redologists
seem to be sages and men of virtue
residing in
the "Illusory Land of Great Void"
and having nothing
whatsoever to do with them.

zh: 他们不管“红学家”究竟议论些什么，只是读下去，读下去。
en:
They, just read on and on,
caring not
what the Redologists may say.

zh: 因此我说，文学批评家无用。
en:
Therefore, I reiterate,
literary criticism is useless.

zh: 不但对读者无用，对作者也无用。
en:
It is useless
not only to the readers,
but also to writers.

zh: 查一查各国文学史，我敢说，没有哪一个伟大作家是根据文学批评家的理论来进行创作的。
en:
Looking up the literary history
of each and every country,
I dare say that
none of the world's great literary figures
ever did their writing
in line with the theory of literary critics.

zh: 那么，文学批评家的研究不就是毫无意义了吗？也不是的。
en:
On the other hand, however,
does it follow that
the research
done by literary critics
is totally meaningless?
No, that is not true either.

zh: 他们根据自己的文学欣赏的才能，根据不同时代潮流，
en:
In accordance with
their own capacity for
literary appreciation
and the different historical trends,

zh: 对文学作品提出自己的看法，互相争论，互相学习，互相启发，互相提高，这也是一种创作活动，对文学理论的建设会有很大的好处。
en:
the views they put forward for
mutual discussion, study,
inspiration and improvement
are also something creative
and conducive to
the development of literary theory.

zh: 只是不要幻想，自己的理论会对读者和作者有多大影响。
en:
Only they should be
under no illusion
about their theories
exerting powerful influence
on the readership or writers.

zh: 这样一来，就可以各安其业，天下太平了。
en:
That is the way for each
to have a role of his own to play
and for peace to reign under heaven.

zh: 上面这些话其实只有幼儿园的水平，
en:
What I've said above
is only skin-deep,
of kindergarten level.

zh: 可是还没有见有什么人这样坦率地说出来。
en:
But so far none else
have ventured to
be equally can did.

zh: 就让我当一个“始作俑者”吧！
en:
Therefore,
let me be reconciled
to being saddled with
the epithet of
" originator of a bad practice".

zh: 寒暑表（=温度计）降到冰点（=零度）下十八度的时候，我们也是在廊下睡觉。
en:
The thermometer had dropped to
18 degrees below zero,
but we still chose to
sleep in the porch as usual.

zh: (+对我而言）每夜最熟识的就是天上的星辰了。
en:
In the evening,
the most familiar sight to me
would be stars in the sky.

zh: 也不过只是点点闪烁的光明，而相看惯了，偶然不见，也有些想望与无聊。
en:
Though they were
a mere sprinkle of twinkling dots,
yet I had become so accustomed to them
that their occasional absence
would bring me loneliness and ennui.

zh: 连夜雨雪，一点星光都看不见。
en:
It had been snowing all night,
not a single star in sight.

zh: 荷（指一个人）和我拥袅对坐，在廊子的两角，遥遥谈话。
en:
My roommate and I,
each wrapped in a quilt,
were seated far apart in
a different corner of the porch,
facing each other and chatting away.

zh: 荷指着说：“你看维纳斯（Venus)升起来了！”
en:
She exclaimed
pointing to something afar,
" Look, Venus is rising!"

zh: 我抬头望时，却是山路转折处的路灯。
en:
I looked up
and saw nothing but a lamp
round the bend
in a mountain path.

zh: 我怡然一笑，也指着对山的一星灯火说：“那边是丘比特（Jupiter)呢！”
en:
I beamed and said pointing to
a tiny lamplight
on the opposite mountain,
"It's Jupiter over there!"

zh: 愈指愈多。
en:
More and more lights
came into sight
as we kept pointing here and there.

zh: 松林中射来零乱的风灯，都成了满天星宿。
en:
Lights from hurricane lamps
flickering about
in the pine forest
created the scene of
a star-studded sky.

zh: 真的，雪花隙里，看不出天空和森林的界限，将繁灯当作繁星，简直是抵得过。
en:
With the distinction
between sky and forest
obscured by snowflakes,
the numerous lamp-lights
now easily passed for as many stars.

zh: 一念至诚的将假作真，灯光似乎都从地上飘起。
en:
Completely lost in make-believe world,
I seemed to see all the lamp-lights
drifting from the ground.

zh: 这幻成的星光，都不移动，不必半夜梦醒时，再去追寻它们的位置。
en:
With the illusory stars
hanging still overhead,
I was spared the effort of tracing their positions
when I woke up from my dreams
in the dead of night.

zh: 于是雨雪寂寞之夜，也有了慰安了。
en:
Thus I found consolation
even on a lonely snowy night.

zh: 最令人忧目惊心的一件事，是看着钟表上的秒针一下一下的移动，每移动一下就是表示我们的寿命已经缩短了一部分。
en:
It is most startling
to hear a watch or clock
clicking away the seconds,
each click indicating
the shortening of one's life by a little bit.

zh: 再看看墙上挂着的可以一张张撕下的日历，每天撕下一张就是表示我们寿命又缩短了一天，
en:
Likewise,
with each page torn off the wall calendar,
one's life is shortened by another day.

zh: 因为时间即生命，没有人不爱惜他的生命，但很少人珍视他的时间。
en:
Time, therefore, is life.
Nevertheless, few people
treasure their time as much as their life.

zh: 如果想在有生之年做一点什么事，学一点什么学问，充实自己，帮助别人，使生命成为有意义，不虚此生，那么就不可浪费光阴。
en:
Time must not be wasted
if you want to do your bit
in your remaining years
or acquire some useful knowledge
to improve yourself and help others,
so that your life may turn out to be
significant and fruitful.

zh: 这道理人人都懂，
en: All that is fool proof,

zh: 可是很少人真能积极不懈的善为利用他的时间。
en:
yet few people really strive to
make the best use of their time.

zh: 我自己就是浪费了很多时间的一个人。
en:
Personally,
I am also a fritterer.

zh: 我不打麻将，我不经常的听戏看电影，几年中难得一次，我不长时间看电视，通常只看半个小时，我也不串门子闲聊天。
en:
I don't play mahjong.
I seldom go to the theatre or cinema
-I go there maybe only once every few years.
I seldom spend long hours watching TV
—usually I watch TV
for no more than 30 minutes at a sitting.
Nor do I go visiting and gossiping from door to door.

zh: 有人问我：“那么你大部分时间都做了些什么呢？”
en:
Some people asked me,
"Then what do you do
with most of your time?"

zh: 我痛自反省，我发现，除了职务上的必须及人情上所不能免的活动外，我的时间大部分都浪费了。
en:
Introspecting with remorse,
I found that apart from the time
earmarked for my job
and unavoidable social activities.
most of my time had been wasted.

zh: 我应该集中精力，读我所未读过的书，我应该利用所有时间，写我所要写的东西。
en:
I should have concentrated
my energies on reading
whatever books I have not yet read.
I should have utilized all my time
in writing anything I want to write.

zh: 但是我没能这样做。我的好多时间都糊里糊涂的混过去了，“少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。”
en:
But I've failed to do so.
Very much of my times has been
frittered away aimlessly.
As the saying goes,
"One who does not work hard in youth
will grieve in vain in old age."

zh: 例如我翻译莎士比亚，
en: Take the translation of Shakespeare for example.

zh: 本来计划于课余之暇每年翻译两部，二十年即可完成，
en:
I had initially planned to spend
20 years of my spare time
in doing the translation,
finishing two plays a year.

zh: 但是我用了三十年，主要的原因是懒。
en:
But I spent 30 years instead,
due primarily to
my slothfulness.

zh: 翻译之所以完成，主要的是因为活得相当长久，十分惊险。
en:
The whole project
would probably have fallen through
had it not been for my fairly long life.

zh: 翻译完成之后，虽然仍有工作计划，但体力渐衰，有力不从心之感。
en:
After that
I had other plans for work,
but, because of my approaching senility,
somehow I failed to do
what I had wished to.

zh: 假使（+在）年轻的时候鞭策自己，
en: Had I spurred myself on/ in my youth,

zh: 如今当有较好或较多的表现。
en:
I would have done
more and better work.

zh: 然而悔之晚矣。
en: Alas, it is too late to repent.

zh: 再例如，作为一个中国人，经书不可不读。
en:
Another example.
The reading of Chinese classics
is a must for all Chinese.

zh: (+但）我年三十才知道读书自修的重要。
en:
But it was not until
I was over 30
that I came to realize the importance of
self-study in the matter of classics.

zh: 我披阅，我圈点。
en:
I did read carefully though,
marking words and phrases
for special attention
with small circles and dots.

zh: 但是恒心不足，时作时辍。
en:
But my efforts at self-study
were off and on.

zh: 五十以学易，可以无大过矣，我如今年过八十，还没有接触过《易经》，说来惭愧。
en:
Confucius says,
"I shall be free of great faults
if I can live long enough
to begin the study of Yi at the age of 50."
I feel ashamed to admit that
I haven't even touched Yi
though I'm now over 80.

zh: 史书也很重要。
en:
Chinese history book
are equally important.

zh: 我出国留学的时候，
en:
father bought a set of
the Tong Wen lithographic edition of
the First Four Books of History.

zh: 塞满了我的行筷的一半空间，
en:
and crammed them
into my travelling box,
taking up half of its space.

zh: 我在外国混了几年之后又把前四史原封带回来了。
en:
Several years later, however,
after drifting along abroad,
I returned home carrying with me
the same books all unread.

zh: 直到四十年后才鼓起勇气读了《通鉴》一遍。
en:
It was not until 40 years later
that I plucked up enough courage
to read through Dong Jian.

zh: 现在我要读的书太多，深感时间有限。
en:
So many books still remain to be read,
and I much regret
not having enough time to do it.

zh: 无论做什么事，健康的身体是基本条件。
en:
Whatever you do,
you need a sound body first of all.

zh: 我在学校读书的时候，有所谓“强迫运动”，
en:
In my school days,
in response to
the so-called "compulsory physical exercises"

zh: 我踢破过几双球鞋，打断过几只球拍。因此侥幸维持下来最低限度的体力。
en:
I went in for many sports
at the expense of
many pairs of sneakers and rackets,
thus luckily building up
a minimum of good physique.

zh: 老来打过几年太极拳，且前则以散步活动筋骨而已。
en:
When I was approaching old age,
I did Tai ji quan (shadow boxing)
for several years.
Now I only do some walking exercises.

zh: 寄语年轻朋友，千万要持之以恒的从事运动，这不是嬉戏，不是浪费时间。
en:
Dear young friends,
my advice to you is:
Do physical exercises perseveringly.
That has nothing to do with
merry-making or time-wasting.

zh: 健康的身体是作人做事的真正的本钱。
en:
Good health is
the wherewithal for
a successful life and career.

zh: 不要抛弃学问 胡适
en: Never Give Up the Pursuit of Learning Hu Shih

zh: 诸位毕业同学，你们现在要离开母校了，我没有什么礼物送给你们，只好送你们一句话罢。（=别的礼物我没有，除了一句话）
en:
Dear students of the Graduating Class,
As you are leaving your alma mater,
I have nothing to offer you as a gift
except a word of advice.

zh: 这一句话是：“不要抛弃学问。”
en:
My advice is,
" Never give up the pursuit of learning."

zh: 以前的功课也许有一大部分是为这张文凭，不得已而做的，
en:
You have perhaps finished
your college courses mostly
for obtaining the diploma,
or, in other words,
out of sheer necessity.

zh: 从今而后，你们可以依自己的心愿去自由研究了。
en:
However, from now
you are free to follow your own bent
in the choice of studies.

zh: 趁现在年富力强的时候，努力做一种学问。
en:
While you are in the prime of life,
why not devote yourselves
to a special field of study?

zh: 少年是一去不复返的，等到（你）精力衰时，努力做学问也来不及了。
en:
Youth will soon be gone never to return.
And it will be too late for you
to go into scholarship
when in your declining years.

zh: 即为吃饭计，学问决不会辜负人的。
en:
Knowledge will do you a good turn
even as a means of subsistence.

zh: 吃饭而不求学问，三年五年后，你们都将要被后来少年淘汰掉的。
en:
If you give up studies while holding a job,
you will in a couple of years
have had yourselves replaced by
younger people.

zh: 到那时再想做点学问来补救，恐怕已太晚了。
en:
It will then be too late
to remedy the situation
by picking up studies again.

zh: 有人说：“出去做事之后，生活问题急需解决，哪有工夫去读书？即使要做学问，既没有图书馆，又没有实验室，哪能做学问？”
en:
Some people say,
"Once you have a job,
you'll come up against
the urgent problem of making a living.
How can you manage to find time to study?
Even if you want to, will it be possible with no library or no laboratory available?"

zh: 我要对你们说：
en: Now let me tell you this.

zh:
凡是要等到有了图书馆才读书的，有了图书馆也不肯读书。
凡是要等到有了实验室才做研究的，有了实验室也不肯做研究。
en:
Those who refuse to study
for lack of a library
will most probably continue to do so
even though there is a library.
And those who refuse to do research
for lack of a laboratory
will most probably continue to do so
even though a laboratory is available.

zh: 你有了决心要研究一个问题，自然会搏衣节食去买书，自然会想出来法子来设置仪器。
en:
As long as you set your mind on studies,
you will naturally cut down on food and clothing
to buy books or do everything possible
to acquire necessary instruments.

zh: 至于时间，更不成问题。达尔文一生多病，不能多作工，每天只能做一点钟的工作。
en:
Time is no object.
Charles Darwin could only
work one hour a day due to ill health.

zh: 你们看他的成绩！每天花一点钟看10页有用的书，每年可看3600多页书，30年可读11万页书。
en:
Yet what a remarkable man he was!
If you spend one hour a day
reading 10 pages of a book,
you can finish more than 3,600 pages a year,
and 110,000 pages in 30 years.

zh: 诸位，11万页书可以使你成一个学者了，
en:
Dear students,
110,000 pages will be quite enough
to make a learned man of you.

zh: 可是，每天看三种小报也得费你一点钟的工夫，四圈麻将也得费你一点半钟的光阴。看小报呢，还打麻将呢？还是努力做一个学者呢？全靠你们自己的选择！
en:
It will take you one hour
to read three tabloids a day,
and one and half hours
to finish four rounds of mah-jong a day.
Reading tabloids, playing mah-jong
or striving to be a learned man,
the choice lies with you.

zh: 易卜生说：“你的最大责任是把你这块材料铸造成器。”
en:
Henrik Ibsen says,
"it is your supreme duty
to cast yourself into a useful implement."

zh: 学问便是铸器的工具。抛弃了学问便是毁了你们自己。
en:
Learning is the casting mould.
Forsake learning,
and you will ruin yourself.

zh: 再会了！你们的母校眼睁睁地要看你们十年之后成什么器。
en:
Farewell!
Your alma mater is watching eagerly
to see what will become of you
ten years from now.

zh: 在电影刊物上看见一个影片的名字：《我若为王》。
en:
Recently in a movie magazine
I came across the title of a film:
If I Were King.

zh: 从这影片的名字，我想到和影片毫无关系的另外的事。
en:
It has put me in mine of
something entirely foreign
to film in question.

zh: 我想，自己如果作了王，这世界会成为一种怎样的光景呢？
en:
I wonder
what would become of this world
if I myself were king.

zh: 这自然是一种完全可笑的幻想，我根本不想作王，也根本看不起王，王是什么东西呢？
en:
This is of course a ridiculous fancy,
for being a king is the last thing I aspire to
and also a thing I utterly despise.
What the hell is a king?

zh: 难道我脑中还有如此封建的残物么？
en:
How can I still be
so feudalistic in my mind?

zh: 而且真想作王的人，他将用他的手去打天下，决不会放在口里说的。
en:
Moreover,
if one is really bent on being a king,
he will try to carry out his design
by deeds instead of by words.

zh: 但是假定又假定，我若为王，这个世界会成为一种怎样的光景？
en:
But, to put it hypothetically,
suppose I were king,
what would this world look like?

zh: 我若为王，自然我的妻就是王后了。
en:
If I were king,
my wife would of course be queen.

zh: 我的妻的德性，我不怀疑，为王后只会有余的。
en:
With all her moral excellence,
of which I make no doubt,
she would be more than qualified
for being a queen.

zh: 但纵然没有任何德性，纵然不过是个姐妓，那时候，她也仍旧是王后。
en:
But even if she had no virtue to speak of,
or were just a whore,
she would be queen all the same.

zh:
一个王后是如何地尊贵呀，
会如何地被人们像捧着天上的星星一样捧来捧去呀，假如我能够想像，那一定是一件有趣的事情。
en:
Imagine how noble and dignified
a queen would be
and how people would keep lauding her
to the skies like mad!
It is indeed great fun for me
to visualize all of this.

zh: 我若为王，我的儿子，假如我有儿子，就是太子或王子了。
en:
If I were king,
my son, if any,
would be crown prince or prince.

zh: 我并不以为我的儿子会是一无所知，一无所能的白痴，
en:
I don't think my son
will be ignorant or worthless
in every way like an idiot.

zh: 但纵然是一无所知一无所能的白痴，也仍旧是太子或王子。
en:
But, even if that were not the case,
he would still be crown prince or prince.

zh: 一个太子或王子中如何地尊贵呀，会如何被人们像捧天上的星星一样地捧来捧去呀。假如我能想像，倒是件不是没有趣味的事。
en:
Imagine how noble and dignified
a crown prince or prince would be
and how people would keep lauding him
to the skies like mad!
It is indeed great fun for me
to visualize all of this.

zh: 我若为王，我的女儿就是公主，我的亲眷都是皇亲国戚。
en:
If I were the king,
my daughters would be princess,
and my relatives by marriage
would all become
members of the royal family.

zh:
无论他们怎样丑陋，怎样顽劣，怎样......
也会被人们像捧天上的星星一样地捧来捧去，因为她们是贵人。
en:
No matter how ugly or perverse
or what not they were,
people would keep lauding them
to the skies like mad just the same
because they were dignitaries.

zh: 我若为王，我的姓名就会改作：“万岁”，我的每一句话都成为：“圣旨”。
en:
If I were king,
I would be addressed as "Your Majesty"
and every word of mine
would become a "royal edict".

zh: 我的意欲，我的贪念，乃至每一个幻想，都可竭尽全体臣民的力量去实现，即使是无法实现的。
en:
All my subjects
would leave no stone unturned
to carry out every will,
every avaricious desire
and even every whim of mine,
even though they were
all beyond the possible.

zh: 我将没有任何过失，因为没有人敢说它是过失；
en:
I would do no wrong simply,
because no one dared to
call it a wrong.

zh: 我将没有任何罪行，因为没有人敢说它是罪行。
en:
I would commit no crime simply
because no one dared to
call it a crime.

zh: 没有人敢呵斥我，指摘我，除非把我从王位上赶下来。但是赶下来，就是我不为王了。
en:
No one would dare to
berate or find fault with me
unless I was removed from the throne,
which meant that
I was no longer the king.

zh: 我将看见所有的人们在我面前低头，鞠躬，匍盒，连同我的尊长，我的师友，和从前曾在我面前昂头阔步耀武扬威的人们。
en:
I would see all people
hang their heads, bow low
or prostrate themselves at my feet,
including my respected elders, teachers, friends
and even those
who had used to swagger arrogantly
in front of me.

zh: 我将看不见一个人的脸，所看见的只是他们的头顶或帽盔。
en:
I could see none of their faces;
all I could see were
the tops of their heads
or hats or helmets on their heads.

zh: 或者所能看见的脸都是谄媚的，乞求的，
en:
The only faces I could see
would be ingratiating or supplicating

zh: 快乐的时候不敢笑，不快乐的时候不敢不笑，
悲戚的时候不敢哭，不悲戚的时候不敢不哭脸。
en:
faces that dared not cry
to express sorrow;
faced that dared not
refrain from a feigned cry
when there was no sorrow
to justify a cry.

zh: 我将听不见人们的真正的声音，
en: I could hear no true voices of my people.

zh: 所能听见的都是低微的，柔婉的，畏葸的和娇痴的，唱小旦的声音：
en:
All I could hear would be
the feeble, soft, timid and affected voice,
like that of a female Peking opera singer,
chanting,

zh: “万岁，万岁！万万岁！”这是他们的全部语言。
en:
Long live the King!
that would be their language in toto.

zh: “有道明君！伟大的主上啊！”这就是那语言的全部内容。
en:
Great is the King,
our enlightened lord!
That would be
the sole content of their language.

zh: 没有在我之上的人了，没有和我同等的人了，
en:
There would be no one above me
or on an equal footing with me.

zh: 我甚至会感到单调，寂寞和孤独。
en:
I would even feel
bored, lonely and isolated.

zh: 为什么人们要这样呢？为什么要捧我的妻，捧我的儿女和亲眷呢？
en:
Why would people behave like that?
Why would they flatter my wife,
my children and my relatives?

zh: 因为我是王，是他们的主子，
en: Because I was king, their master.

zh: 我将恍然大悟：我生活在这些奴才们中间，连我所敬畏的尊长和师友也无一不是奴才，而我自己不过是一个奴才的首领。
en:
It would suddenly dawn on me that
living among these flunkeys,
including my esteemed elders,
teachers and friends,
I myself,too,
was nothing but a mere head flunkey.

zh: 我是民国的国民，
en: I am the citizen of the Republic.

zh:
民国国民的思想和生活习惯
使我深深地憎恶一切奴才或奴才相，连同敬畏的尊长和师友们。
en:
Being accustomed to the mode of thinking
and living of a republican citizen,
I would deeply abhor all servility and flunkeys,
including my esteemed elders, teachers and friends.

zh: 请科学家们不要见笑，
en:
Dear scientists,
please don't laugh at me.

zh: 我以为世界之所以还有待于改进者，全因为有这些奴才的缘故。
en:
Methinks
the world is very much
in need of reform simply
because of
the presence of these flunkeys,

zh:
生活在奴才们中间，作奴才们的首领，
我将引为生平的最大耻辱，最大的悲哀。
en:
I would regard it as
the deepest disgrace and sorrow of my life
to live among the flunkeys
and become their chief.

zh:
我将变成一个暴君，或者反而是明君；
我将把我的臣民一齐杀死，连同尊长和师友，不准一奴种留在人间。
en:
I would rather become
a tyrant or an enlightened king
so that I could kill off all my subjects,
among them my respected elders,
teachers and friends,
and have the flunkey species
exterminated once for all.

zh: 我将没有一个臣民，我将不再是奴才们的君主。
en:
Then, with all my subjects gone,
I would no longer be
the king of flunkeys.

zh:
我若为王，将终于不能为王，
却也真地为古今中外最大的王了。
en:
If I were king
and ultimately ended up
becoming no king at all,
I would indeed be the greatest king
that had ever breathed since time immemorial.

zh: “万岁，万岁，万万岁！”我将和全世界的真的人们一同三呼。
en:
I would join true people all the world over in
giving three cheers for myself.

zh: 作家有三种死法。一曰自然的死，二曰痛苦的死，三曰快乐的死。
en:
A writer can die
three kinds of death:
natural death,
painful death, happy death.

zh: 自然的死属于心脏停止跳动，是一种普遍的死亡形式，没有特色，可以略而不议。
en:
Natural death,
caused by the discontinuation of heartbeat,
is a common form of death
with no characteristics of its own,
and therefore may as well
be left out without any comment.

zh: 快乐的死和痛苦的死不属于心脏停止跳动，是人还活着，作品已经、或几乎是没有了！
en:
In the case of
happy death and painful death,
which are not caused by
the discontinuation of heartbeat,
the writer,alive as he is,
has stopped or almost stopped writing!

zh: 作家没有了作品，可以看作是个人艺术生命的死亡、职业的停顿。
en:
When a writer
no longer produces any works,
it is tantamount to
the death of his artistic life
or the end of his career.

zh: 其中有些人是因为年事已高，力不从心。
en:
Some writers lay down their pens
because they are
too old to be equal to the task.

zh: 这不是艺术的死亡，而是艺术的离休，
en:
We call it retirement from art
rather than death of art.

zh: 他自己无可自责，社会也会尊重他在艺术上曾经作出的贡献。
en:
They have nothing to blame themselves for.
And society at large
will pay tribute to the contributions
they have already made to art.

zh: 痛苦的死亡却不然，即当一个作家的体力和脑力还能胜任创作的时候，作品已经没有了，其原因主要是由于各种苦难和折磨（包括自我折磨）所造成。
en:
Painful death is quiet another matter.
It occurs when a writer abandons writing
even though he is still sound in mind and body.
It results mainly from
various kinds of sufferings and torments
(including self-inflicted torments).

zh: 折磨毁了他的才华，苦难消沉了意志，作为人来说他还活着，作为作家来说却正在或已死去。
en:
Torments ruin his talent
while sufferings demoralize him.
Though still alive as a man,
he is dying or already dead as a writer.

zh: 这种死亡他自己感到很痛苦，别人看了心里也很难受。
en:
This kind of death
causes not only much pain
to the writer himself,
but much sadness
to other people as well.

zh: 快乐的死亡却很快乐，不仅他自己感到快乐，别人看来也很快乐。
en:
Happy death is a joyful thing,
bring happiness to
both the writer himself and other people.

zh:
昨天看见他大会上做报告，下面掌声如雷；
今天又看见他参加宴会，为这为那地频频举杯。
en:
Yesterday we saw him
addressing a big meeting
amidst thunderous applause,
and today we saw him attending a banquet,
drinking nonstop to this and that.

zh: 昨天听见他在高朋中大发议论，语惊四座，
en:
Yesterday we heard him
talking volubly to
a gathering of distinguished guests,
capturing the attention of all present,

zh: 今天又听见他在那些开不完的座谈会上重复昨天的意见。
en:
and today we heard him
repeating himself
at one of those endless forums.

zh: 昨天看见他在北京的街头，今天又看见他飞到了广州......
en:
Yesterday we met him
on a Beijing street,
and today we saw him
flying to Guangzhou...

zh: 只是看不到或很少看到他的作品发表哪里。
en:
But never or every seldom
do we find his new works
seeing the light of day.

zh: 我不害怕自然的死，因为害怕也没用，人人不可避免。
我也不太害怕痛苦的死，因为那时代已经过去。
en:
Nor do I fear painful death
for it is something belonging to
a bygone age.

zh: 我最害怕的就是那快乐的死，毫无痛苦，十分热闹，甚至还有点轰轰烈烈。
en:
What I fear most is happy death,
which is absolutely painless
and full of bustle, excitement
and even dramatic spectacle.

zh: 自己很难控制，即很难控制在一定的范围之内。
en:
It is difficult to exercise self-control,
that is, difficult to keep within limits.

zh: 因为我觉得喝酒不一定完全是坏事，少喝一点可以舒筋活血，据说对心血管也是有帮助的。
en:
Drinking is, to my mind,
not always bad
because a few spots
may help blood circulation
and is, as they say,
good for the heart and blood vessels.

zh: 作家不能当隐士，适当的社会活动和文学活动可以开阔眼界，活跃思想，对创作也是有帮助的。
en:
Being no hermit,
a writer stands to benefit in writing
as long as he gets properly involved with
social and literary activities
to widen his field of vision
and stimulate his thinking.

zh: 可是怎么才能不酗酒、不作酒鬼，这有益的定量究竟是多少呢？
en:
But how can he
avoid excessive drinking
or becoming of drunkard?
What is the safety limit
in this respect?

zh: 怕就怕三杯下肚，豪情大发，嘟嘟嘟，来个瓶底朝天，
en:
The trouble is after three cups of alcohol
he will get wild and unrestrained
and end in gulping down a whole bottle.

zh: 而且一顿喝不上便情绪不高，颇有怨言，甚至会到处去找酒喝。
en:
One meal without liquor will upset him
and set him complaining
and searching around for drink.

zh: 呜呼，快乐地死去！
en: Alas,just to end up dying happily!

zh: 学问与趣味 梁实秋
en: Learning and Personal Inclination Liang Shiqiu

zh: 前辈的学者常以学问的趣味启迪后生，
en:
Scholars of the older generation
often urge young people to
develop interest in learning

zh: 因为他们自己实在是得到了学问的趣味，
en:
because they themselves
have been enjoying
the real pleasure of academic studies.

zh: 故不惜现身说法，诱导后学，
en:
And they are ever ready to
cite their own example
by way of advice,

zh: 使他们也在愉快的心情之下走进学问的大门。
en:
in hopes of enabling young people
to gain access to scholarship
in an enjoyable way.

zh: 例如，梁任公先生就说过：
en:
For example,
the distinguished scholar Liang Qichao
once said wittily,

zh: 我是个主张趣味主义的人，
en:
I always stand for interest-ism. ★两个小词：
stand for代表；为…而奋斗；拥护
interest-ism 趣味主义
★趣味主义：译为interest-ism,其中“-ism”乃表达“主义”而采用的英语后缀。
“Dengism”→邓小平理论；“Maoism”→毛泽东思想；“Marxism”→马克思主义连这句了三个例子，可算是清楚了吧？“XXX-ism”就是“XXX思想/主义/等等”。
19 倘若用化学化分梁启超’这件东西，
把里头所含一种原素名叫‘趣味’的抽出来， If you broke down Liang Qichao's stuff
into its component parts, 如果你将梁启超这个东西打碎，
分解成许多小块块。 ★倘若用化学化分梁启超’这件东西：译为 If you broke down Liang Qichao's stuff into its component parts,其中短语动词 broke down 意即“分解”（to decompose),例如 Water can be broken down into hydrogen and oxygen。
★component part:“component”是成分，“part”也是表示部分，部分的部分就真的是分解的很碎了。
component n.成分；零件；[数]要素；组分；
19 只怕所剩下的仅有个零了。 there would be nothing left
except an element named 'interest'.

zh: 任公先生注重趣味，学问甚是渊博，
en:
Mr. Liang was a man of profound learning
who attached much importance to interest.

zh: 而并不存有任何外在的动机，只是“无所为而为”，故能有他那样的成就。
en:
He attained great academic success
because he pursued scholarly study solely
for its own sake,
without any ulterior motive.

zh: 一个人在学问上果能感觉到趣味，有时真会像是着了魔一般，
en:
A man who is really interested in learning
sometimes does act like one possessed.

zh: 真能废寝忘食，真能不知老之将至，苦苦钻研，镶而不舍，在学问上焉能不有收获？
en:
He forgets his approaching old age
and works hard even to
the neglect of his meals and sleep.
Isn't it but natural
for a man of such devotion
to have great scholarly achievements?

zh: 不过我尝想，以任公先生而论，他后期的著述如历史研究法，先秦政治思想史，以及有关墨子佛学陶渊明的作品，
en:
But, though Mr. Liang's later works,
such as those on method of historical studies,
political and ideological history of the pre-Qin days,
as well as those on Mohism,
Buddhism and Tao Yuanming,

zh: 都可说是他的一点“趣味”在驱使着他，
en:
were motivated by
his personal inclination,

zh: 可是在他在年青的时候，从师受业，诵读典籍，那时节也全然是趣味么？
en:
can the same be said of his younger days
when he was a pupil
chanting ancient Chinese books
under a private tutor?

zh: 作八文，作试帖诗，莫非也是趣味么？我想未必。
en:
Was he motivated by his personal inclination
while learning to write stereotyped essays
and poems prescribed for
the imperials civil service examinations?
No, I think not.

zh: 大概趣味云云，是指年长之后自动/作学问之时/而言，在年青时候/为学问打根底之际/恐怕不能过分重视趣味。
en:
Generally speaking,
the so-called interest begins to exist
only when one is mature enough
to engage in independent studies.
It is improper, I am afraid,
for young people to over stress
the importance of interest
while they are still in
the period of learning the basics of knowledge.

zh: 学问没有根底，趣味也很难滋生。
en:
Interest will never develop where no solid foundation
has been laid for learning.

zh: 任公先生的学问之所以那样的博大精深，涉笔成趣，左右逢源，不能不说的一大部分得力于他的学问根底之打得坚固。
en:
There is no denying the fact that
Mr. Liang owed his
wide erudition and unusual literary talent,
for the most part,
to his good grasp of foundation knowledge.

zh:
我尝见许多年青的朋友，聪明用功，成绩优异，
而语文程度不足以达意，甚至写一封信亦难得通顺，
问其故则曰其兴趣不在语文方面。
先别急，容我大白话来一遍：
【我曾经见过许多年轻的朋友，他们聪明用功，成绩优异
不过语文成都不能传文达意，甚至写信都写不通顺，
问他为什么？他就说他的兴趣不在语文上。】
en:
I have come across a great many
bright and diligent young friends
who have done exceedingly well
in their studies,
but are rather weak in Chinese.
They cannot even write a letter
in correct Chinese.
When I asked them why,
they said they were
not interested in the Chinese language.

zh: 又有一些位，执笔为文，斐然可诵，而视数理科如仇兽，勉强才能及格，
en:
Some, though they can write beautifully,
detest the study of,
and barely managed to
pass the examinations in them.

zh: 问其故则亦曰其兴趣不在数理方面，
en:
When I asked them why,
they said they were not interested in theml

zh: 而且他们觉得某些科目没有趣味，便撇在一旁视如敞疑，
en:
They cast away
whatever subjects they dislike
like something utterly worthless.

zh: 怡然自得，振振有词，略无愧色，好像这就是发扬趣味主义。
en:
They are so smug and thick-skinned
that they speak volubly
in defence of their own attitude
like champions of interest-ism.

zh: 殊不知天下没有没有趣味的学问，端视吾人如何发掘其趣味，
en:
They hardly realize that
there is no learning
but is capable of engendering interest
and that all depends on
how to search for it.

zh:
如果在良师指导之下按部就班的循序而进，
一步一步的发现新天地，当然乐在其中，
en:
You will develop a liking for learning if,
under the guidance of a good teacher,
you study to discover
new horizons opening up before you
one after another
by following the proper order
and advancing step by step.

zh: 如果浅尝辄止，甚至躏等躁进，当然味同嚼蜡，自讨没趣。
en:
On the other hand,
you will find learning as dry as saw dust
and feel frustrated
if you refuse to go into a subject in depth
or even make impetuous advances
without following the proper order.

zh: 一个有中上天资的人，对于普通的基本的文理科目，都同样的学习的能力，绝不会本能的长于此而拙于彼。
en:
People with an average natural gift
are equally capable of mastering
the basics of liberal arts and natural science.
They are never predetermined by nature
to be good in one subject and poor in another.

zh: 只有懒惰与任性，才能使一个人自甘暴弃的在“趣味”的掩护之下败退。
en:
It is laziness and waywardness,however,
that causes one to give himself up
as hopeless and back down
on the pretext of "no interest".

zh: 由小学到中学，所修习的无非是一些普通的基本知识。
en:
Primary and secondary school
will impart to you
only some rudiments of knowledge.

zh: 就是大学四年，所授课业也还是相当粗浅的学识。
en:
Even what you learn
during the four years of university
will be something quite superficial too.

zh: 世人常称大学为“最高学府”，这名称易滋误解，好像过此以上即无学问可言。
en:
A university has often been
misleadingly referred to as
"the highest seat of learning",
which sounds as if
there were no more learning to speak of beyond it.

zh: 大学的研究所才是初步研究学问的所在，在这里作学问也只能算是粗涉藩篱，注重的是研究学问的方法与实习。
en:
The research institute of a university,however,
is the place for preliminary scholarship.
But even there
you get only the first taste of learning
and the emphasis is
on research methodology and practice.

zh:
学无止境，一生的时间都嫌太短，
所以古人皓首穷经，头发白了还是在继续研究，不过在这样的研究中确是有浓厚的趣味。
en:
Art is long, life is short.
That is why
some of our ancients continued to study
even when they were hoary headed.
They were, of course,
motivated by an enormous interest in their studies

zh: 在初学的阶段，由小学至大学，我们与其倡言趣味，不如偏重纪律。
en:
During the preliminary stage of learning
,from primary school to college,
it is better to advocate discipline than interest.

zh:
一个合理编列的课程表，犹如一个营养均衡的食谱，
里面各个项目都是有益而必需的，
不可偏废，不可再有选择。
en:
A properly arranged school curriculum,
like a cookbook
on nutritionally well-balanced food,
must include all useful
and indispensable courses-
courses which are
equally important and obligatory.

zh: 所谓选修科目，也只是在某一项目范围内略有拣选余地而已。
en:
The so-called electives
mean only some little option
within the scope of a certain item.

zh: 一个受过良好教育的人，犹如一个科班出身的戏剧演员，
en:
A well-educated person is like
a professionally trained
Peking opera singer.

zh: 在坐科的时候他是要服从严格纪律的，
en:
While undergoing the training,
he must observe a most exact discipline.

zh: 唱工作工武把子都要认真学习，各种角色的戏都要完全谱通，
en:
He must pay equal attention to
singing,acting and acrobatic skills,
and learn to play different roles.

zh: 学成之后才能各按其趣味而单独发展其所长。
en:
It is not until
he has finished the all-round training
that he begins to develop his own speciality
according to his personal disposition.

zh: 学问要有根底，根底要打平正坚实，以后永远受用。
en: Laying a solid foundation for learningwill be of great lifelong benefit to you.

zh: 初学阶段的科目之最重要的莫过于语文与数学。
en:
Of all the school subjects
during the preliminary stage of learning,
languages and mathematics
are the most important.

zh: 语文是阅读达意的工具，
en:
Languages serve as a tool for
reading and communication.

zh: 国文不能便很难表达自己，外国文不能便很难吸取外来的新知。
en:
Without a good knowledge of Chinese,
you will find it difficult to express yourself.
Without a good knowledge of a foreign language,
you will find it difficult to
absorb new knowledge from abroad.

zh: 数学是思想条理之最好的训练。
en: Mathematics makes for logical thinking.

zh: 其他科目也各有各的用处，其重要性很难强分轩轻，例如体育，从另一方面看也是重要得无以复加。
en:
Other subjects also have theirapos;respective uses.
It is hard to say which is more important.
Physical education, for example,
is also extremely important
from another point of view.

zh: 总之，我们在求学时代，应该暂且把趣味放在一旁，耐着性子接受教育的纪律，把自己锻炼成为坚实的材料。
en:
In short, while in school,
we should temporarily put aside our personal liking
and patiently observe school discipline
so that we may temper ourselves
and become solid stuff.

zh: 学问的趣味，留在将来慢慢享受一点也不迟。
en:
Don't hurry-
there will be a time for you
to find relish in learning
in the days to come.

zh: 祖父、伯父母、叔父母和堂姐妹兄弟，都没有把我当作野孩子，大家也都很亲呢平等，并没有什么“规矩”。
en:
My grandpa, uncles, aunties and cousins
never thought me a naughty child.
We treated each other lovingly and equally.
There never existed anything
like"family rules of good behaviour".

zh:
我还觉得我们这个大家庭是几个小家庭的很松散的组合。
每个小家庭都是各住各个的，各吃各的，各自有自己的亲戚朋友，
比如说，我们就各自有自己的“外婆家”！
en:
I also found that
the big family was
a loose community of several smaller ones,
which lived and ate separately.
They each had their own relatives and friends,
for example, their own in-laws.

zh:
就在这一年，也许是第二年吧，福州有了电灯公司。
我们这所大房子里也安上了电灯，这在福州也是一件新鲜事，
我们这班孩子跟着安装的工人们满房子跑，非常地兴奋欢喜！
en:
That year, or the year after,
Fuzhou began to have its own power company
and electric lights were
to be installed in our big house too.
That was something new in our home town.
We kids, wild with excitement and joy,
ran here and there in the house
at the heels of the electricians.

zh:
我记得这电灯是从房顶上吊下来的，每间屋子都有一盏，
厅堂上和客室里的五十支光，卧房里的光小一些，厨房里的就更小了。
我们这所大房子里至少也五六十盏灯，第一夜亮起来时，真是灯火辉煌，我们孩子们都拍手欢呼！
en:
The whole big house at least
had a total of some 60 electric lamps.
The first evening when they were turn on,
the whole house was
suddenly ablaze with lights,
we kids clapped with joy.

zh: 但是总电门是安在祖父的屋里的。
en:
The master switch
was fixed in grandpa's room.

zh:
祖父起得很早也睡得很早，每晚九点钟就上床了。
他上床之前，就把电闸关上，于是整个大家庭就是黑沉沉的一片！
en:
Grandpa, who kept early hours,
would switch off all the lights
when he went to bed
at 9 o'clock in the evening,
thus plunging the whole big house
into deep darkness.

zh: 我们刚回老家，父母亲和他们的兄弟她埋都有许多别情要叙，我们一班弟兄姐妹，也在一起玩得正起劲，都很少在晚九点以前睡的。
en:
Having just set foot in our old home,
we seldom slept before 9 o'clock in the evening.
For it was but natural that after the long separation,
my parents enjoyed hearty chats about the old days
with their brothers and in-laws,
and we kids of the younger generation
played about together to our heart's content.

zh: 为了防备这骤然的黑暗，于是每晚在九点以前，每个小家庭都在一两间屋里，点上一盏捻得很暗的煤油灯。
en:
Hence, in anticipation of
the sudden blackout at 9 o'clock,
each small family would get
a dimly-lit kerosene lamp ready
in a couple of their rooms.

zh: 一到九点，电灯一下子都灭了，这几盏煤油灯便都捻亮了
en:
No sooner had the big house
been blacked out on the hour
than we turned up
the wicks of all the kerosene lamps.

zh: 大家相视而笑，又都在灯下谈笑玩耍。
en:
And, looking and smiling at each other,
we would continue to chat and play merrily
by the light of the kerosene lamps.

zh: 只有在这个时候，我才体会到我们这个大家庭是一个整体，而祖父是一家之主！
en:
It was then that I realized
what a complete whole our big family was,
with grandpa as its head.

zh: 祖父和灯火管制 冰心
en: Grandpa and Nightly Blackout Bing Xin

zh: 一九一一年秋，我们从山东烟台回到福州老家去。
en:
In the autumn of 1911,
we returned from Yantai of Shandong Province
to our native place Fuzhou.

zh: 在还乡的路上，母亲和父亲一再嘱咐我，“回到福州住在大家庭里，不能再像野孩子似的，一切都要小心。对长辈们不能没大没小的。祖父是一家之主，尤其要尊敬......”
en:
While on the way,
my parents warned me again and again,
"Since we'll be living in a big family in Fuzhou,
remember always to behave properly
and never act like a naughty child.
Show respect for your elders,
particularly your grandpa,
who is head of the family..."

zh: 到了福州，在大家庭里住了下来，我觉得我在归途中的担心是多余的。
en:
After settling down
in the big family in Fuzhou,
however, I found that
my previous worries on the way
turned out to be unfounded.

zh: 《激流》总序 巴金
en: Preface to the Torrent Trilogy Ba Jin

zh: 几年前我流了眼泪读完托尔斯泰小说《复活》，曾经在扉页上写了一句话：“生活本身就是一个悲剧。”
en:
Several years ago,
after I finished reading
Leo Tolstoy's Resurrection
with tears in my eyes,
I wrote on its title page,
"Life itself is a tragedy".

zh:
事实并不是这样。生活并不是一个悲剧。它是一个“搏斗”。我们生活来做什么？
或者说我们为什么要有这生命？罗曼.罗兰的回答是“为的是来征服它”。我认为他说得不错。
en:
However, that is not how things are,
for life is not a tragedy, but a“struggle”.
What do we live for?
Or why do we live this life at all?
The answer given by Roman Rolland
is "to conquer life". I think he is right.

zh: 我有了生命以来，在这个世界上虽然仅仅经历了二十几个寒暑，但是这短短的时期也并不是白白度过的。
en:
Ever since I was born,
I have passed no more than
twenty odd summers in this world,
but this short period of time
has not been spent for nothing at all.

zh: 这其间我也曾看见了不少的东西，知道了不少的事情。
en:
I have since seen a lot of things
and come to know a lot of things.

zh: (+尽管）我的周围是无边的黑暗，但是我并不孤独，并不绝望。
en:
Though it is all darkness around me,
I have never felt lonely,
nor have I ever given up hope.

zh: 我无论在什么地方总看见那一股生活的激流在动荡，在创造它自己的道路，通过乱山碎石中间
en:
Everywhere I go,
I always see the torrent of life
tumbling along to open up its way
through a confused mass of
mountains and rocks.

zh: 这激流永远动荡着，并不曾有一个时候停止过，而且它也不能够停止；
没有什么东西可以阻止它。
en: Nothing whatever can hold it up.

zh:
在它的途中，它也曾发射出种种的水花，
这里面有爱，有恨，有欢乐，也有痛苦。
en:
While on its way,
it sometimes throws clouds of spray into the air
embodying love and hate,
and happiness and sorrow.

zh: 这一切造成了奔腾的一股激流，具有排山之势，向着唯一的海流去。
en:
All that makes up the tumultuous torrent
rushing with terrific force
towards the only sea.

zh: 这唯一的海是什么，而且什么时候它才可以流到这海里，就没有人确定地知道了。
en:
No one knows for sure
what that only sea is
and when the torrent is going to
empty into it.

zh: 我跟所有其余的人一样，生活在这世界上，是为着来征服生活。
en:
Like everybody else,
I live in this world
for the purpose of conquering life.

zh: 我也曾参加在这个“搏斗”里面。
en: I have also taken part in the "struggle".

zh: 我有我的爱，有我的恨，有我的欢乐，也有我的痛苦。
en:
I have my own love and hate,
and happiness and sorrow.

zh: 但是我并没有失去我的信仰：对于生活的信仰。
en:
But I have never lost my faith
——a faith in life.

zh: 我的生活还不会结束，我也不知道在前面还有什么东西等着我。
en:
There is still some way to go
before my life runs out,
and I do not know
what the future has in store for me.

zh: 然而我对于将来的却也有一点概念。因为过去并不是一个沉默的哑子，它会告诉我们一些事情。
en:
Nevertheless,
I am not without some idea of
what the future is like
because the past,
being no silent mute,
will give me some hint.

zh: 在这里我所要展开给读者看的乃是过去十多年生活的一幅图画。
en:
What I unfold here in the Trilogy
before my readers
is a picture of life
of the past ten odd years.

zh: 自然这里只有生活的一小部分，但已经可以看见那一股由爱与恨、欢乐与受苦所组织成的生活的激流是如何地在动荡了。
en:
Of course it reflects
only a small section of life,
but enough, however,
to afford a glimpse of
the turbulent torrent of life
with its love and hate,
happiness and sorrow.

zh: 我不是一个说教者，所以我不能够明确地指出一条路来，但是读者自己可以在里面去找它。
en:
I am no religious preacher,
so I cannot point out a definite way out.Readers may here
find a way out for themselves.

zh: 有人说过，路本没有，因为走的人多了，便成了一条路。
en:
Some say that
there is at first no road at all
and that a road is created simply
by the treading of passers-by.

zh: 又有人说路是有的，正因为有了路才有许多人走。
en:
Others say that
there is at first already a road available
before more and more people
come to walk on it.

zh: 谁是谁非，我不想判断。（中文先废话）
en:
I do not want to judge
who are right or who are wrong.(英文先主句）

zh: 我还年轻，我还要活下去，我还要征服生活。
en:
I am still young,
I want to live on,
I want to conquer life.

zh: 我知道生活的激流是不会停止的，且看它把我载到什么地方去！
en:
I know the torrent of life will never stop.
Let's see where is it going to carry me!

zh: 离别 郑振铎
en: Parting Sorrows Zheng Zhenduo

zh: 别了，我爱的中国，我全心爱着的中国，
en: Farewell, China, my beloved homeland!

zh: 当我倚在高高的船栏上，见着船渐渐的离岸了，船与岸间的水面渐渐的阔了，见着了许多亲友挥着白巾，挥着帽子，挥着手，说着Adieu,adieu!
en:
Leaning over the high railing,
I watched the ship tearing itself away
slowly from the shore,
leaving a widening expanse of water in between.
Many relatives and friends of mine were
waving their hats and white handkerchiefs
amidst shouts of"Adieu,adieu!"

zh: 听着鞭炮劈劈拍拍的响着，
en: firecrackers were crackling and spluttering,

zh: 水兵们高呼着向岸上的同伴告别时，
en:
and sailors shouting goodbye
to their buddies on the shore.

zh: 我的眼眶是润湿了，我自知我的泪点已经滴在眼镜面了，镜面是模糊了，我有一种说不出的感动！
en:
I was seized with violent emotion,
tears welling up in my eyes
and blurring my eyeglasses.

zh:
船慢慢的向前驶着，沿途见了停着的好几只灰色的白色的军舰。
不，那不是悬着我们国旗的，
en:
While the ship was steering ahead slowly,
I saw on the way many
warship sin gray or white
lying at anchor and fly flags
other than our national ones.

zh:
它们的旗帜是“红日”，是“蓝白红”，
是“红蓝条交叉着”的联合旗，是有“星点红条”的旗！
en:
They were flying the red sun,
the tricolour,
the union jack
or the stars and stripes.

zh: 两岸是黄土和青草，再过去是两条的青痕，再过去是地平线上的几座小岛山，
en:
The banks
with their yellowish soil and green grass
receded into two greenish strips
until they became some mere islets
on the horizon.

zh: 海水满盈盈的照在夕阳之下，浪涛如顽皮的小童似的踊跃不定。水面上现出片的金光。
en:
The waters of the sea
glistened under the setting sun
and kept leaping like romping urchins.
The water surface
was a vast expanse of gold.

zh: 我不忍离了中国而去，
en:
I cannot find it in my heart
to leave China,

zh: 更不忍在这大时代中放弃每人应做的工作而去，抛弃了许多亲爱的勇士在后面，
en:
much less during these stormy times
when I have to abandon my bounden duty
and leave behind so many dear brave fighters

zh: 他们是正用他们的血建造着新的中国，正在以纯挚的热诚，争斗着，奋击着。
en:
-men who are building a new China
with their own blood
and struggling and battling
in all earnest.

zh: 我这样不负责任的离开了中国，我真是一个罪人！
en:
To quit China at this moment
means to dodge my responsibility,
and that makes me feel very guilty indeed!

zh: 然而我终将在这大时代中工作着的，我终将为中国而努力，而呈献了我的身，我的心；
en:
Nevertheless,
I shall eventually answer
the call of the times
and devote myself heart and soul
to my motherland.

zh: 我别了中国，为的是求更好的经验，求更好的奋斗工具。
en:
I am parting from China
acquire more experience
and search for better ways of struggle.

zh: 暂别了，暂别了，在各方面争斗着的勇士们，我不久即将以更勇猛的力量加入你们当中了。
en:
Dear brave fighters of every field,
I shall be separated from you
only for the present
and will soon return to join your ranks
with redoubled strength.

zh: 当我归来时，我希望这些悬着“红日”的，“蓝白红”的，有“星点红条”的，“红蓝条交叉着”的一切旗帜的白色灰色的军舰都已不见了，
en:
On my return, I hope,
I shall see no more gray or white warships
plying our territorial waters
with flags of the red sun, the tricolour,
the union jack or the stars and stripes.

zh: 代替它们的是我们的可喜爱的悬着我们的旗帜的伟大的舰队。
en:
I hope
I shall see instead our lovely great fleet
flying our national colours.

zh: 如果它们那时还没有退去中国海，还没有为我们所消灭，那末，来，勇士们，我将加入你们的队中，以更勇猛的力量，去压迫它们，去毁灭它们！
en:
Dear brave fighters,
if the foreign warships by that time
still hang on their presence
in our territorial waters,
I will join you to do my bit
in getting rid of them.

zh: 这是我的誓言！
en: That is my pledge!

zh: 雨声渐渐的住了，窗帘后隐隐的透进清光来。
en:
As the rain gradually ceased to patter,
a glimmer of light began to
filter into the room
through the window curtain.

zh: 推开窗户一看，
en:
I opened the window
and looked out.

zh: 呀！凉云散了①，树叶上的残滴②，映着月儿③，好似萤光千点④，闪闪烁烁的动着⑤
en:
Ah, the rain clouds had vanished①
and the remaining raindrops②
on the tree leaves glistened tremulously⑤
under the moonlight③
like myriads of fireflies④

zh: 真没想到苦雨孤灯之后，会有这么一幅清美的图画！
en:
To think that
there should appear before my eyes
such a beautiful sight
after the miserable rain
on a lonely evening.

zh: 凭窗站了一会儿，微微的觉得凉意侵入。
en:
Standing at the window for a while,
I felt a bit chilly.

zh:
转过身来，忽然眼花缭乱，屋子里的别的东西，都隐在光云里；
一片幽辉，只浸着墙上画中的安琪儿。
en:
As I turned round,
my eyes suddenly dazzled
before the bright light
and could not see things distinctly.
Everything in the room was blurred
by a haze of light
except the angel in a picture
on the wall.

zh: 这白衣安琪儿，抱着花儿，扬着翅儿，向着我微微的笑。
en:
The angel in white was smiling on me
with a bunch of flowers in his arms,
his wings flapping.

zh: “这笑容仿佛在那儿看见过似的，什么时候，我曾……”我不知不觉的便坐在窗口下想，——默默的想。
en:
“I seem to have seen the same smile before.
When was that?..."
Before I knew,
I had sunk into a chair under the window,
lost in meditation.

zh: 严闭的心幕，慢慢的拉开了，涌出五年前的一个印象。——条很长的古道。
en:
A scene of five years ago
slowly unveiled
before my mind's eye.
It was a long ancient country road.

zh: 驴脚下的泥，兀自滑滑的。
en:
The ground under my donkey's feet
was slippery with mud.

zh: 田沟里的水，潺潺的流着。
en:
The water in the field ditches
was murmuring.

zh: 近村的绿树，都笼在湿烟里。
en:
The green trees in the neighbouring village
were shrouded in a mist.

zh: 弓儿似的新月，挂在树梢。
en:
The crescent new moon
looked as if hanging on
the tips of the trees.

zh: 一边走着，似乎道旁有一个孩子，抱着一堆灿白的东西。
en:
As I passed along,
I somewhat sensed
the presence of a child by the roadside
carrying something snow white in his arms.

zh: 驴儿过去了，无意中回头一看。——他抱着花儿，赤着脚儿，向着我微微的笑。
en:
After the donkey had gone by,
I happened to look back and saw the child.
Who was barefoot,
looking at me smilingly
with a bunch of flowers in his arms.

zh: “这笑容又仿佛是那儿看过似的！”我仍是想——默默的想。
en:
I seem to have seen
the same smile somewhere before!
I was still thinking to myself.

zh: 又现出一重心幕来，也慢慢的拉开了，涌出十年前的一个印象。
en:
Another scene,
a scene of ten years ago,
slowly unfolded before my mind's eyes.

zh: ——茅檐下的雨水，一滴一滴的落到衣上来。
en:
Rainwater was falling drop by drop
onto my clothes
from the eaves of a thatched cottage.

zh: 土阶边的水泡儿，泛来泛去的乱转。
en:
Beside the earthen doorstep,
bubbles in puddles of rainwater
were whirling about like mad.

zh: 门前的麦珑和葡萄架子，都濯（灌洗）得新黄嫩绿的非常鲜丽。
en:
Washed by the rain,
the wheat fields and grape trellises
in front of the cottage door
presented a picturesque scene
of vivid yellow and tender green.

zh: 一会儿好容易雨情了，连忙走下坡去。
en:
After a while,
it cleared up at long last
and I hurried down the slope.

zh: (+我）迎头看见月儿从海面（+升）上来了，猛然记得有件东西忘下了，站住了，回过头来。这茅屋里的老妇人——她倚着门儿，抱着花儿，向着我微微的笑。
en:
Up ahead I saw the moon
rising high above the sea.
Suddenly it occurred to me
that I had left something behind.
When I stopped and turned round,
my eyes fell on an old woman
at her cottage door smiling at me,
a bunch of flowers in her arms.

zh: 这同样微妙的神情，好似游丝一般，飘飘漾漾的合了拢来，馆在一起。
en:
The three subtle smiles,
drifting in the air
towards each other like gossamer,
became interwoven.

zh:
这时心下光明澄静，如登仙界，如归故乡。
眼前浮现的三个笑容，一时融化在爱的调和里看不分明了。
en:
At this moment
all was bright, clear and clam in my heart.
I felt as if I were ascending to heaven
or on the way back to my hometown.
In my mind's eye,
the three smiling faces
now merged into a harmonious whole of love
and became indistinguishable.

zh:
清晓的江头，
白雾茫茫；
是江南天气，
雨儿来了——
我只知道有蔚蓝的海，
却原来还有碧绿的江，
这是我父母之乡！
—繁星156
en:
The River mouth at dawn,
Behind a white haze of mist,
'Tis southern climes,
Behold, the rain is coming.
I have seen the blue sea all, along,
Little aware of this green River,
O the land of my ancestors!
--Sparkling Stars, 156

zh: 福建福州永远是我的故乡，虽然我不在那里生长，但它是我的父母之乡！
en:
Fuzhou of Fujian Province
will always be my old home.
Though I was brought up elsewhere,
Fuzhou is nevertheless
the land of my ancestors!

zh: 到今日为止，我这一生中只回去过两次。
en:
As yet,
I have been back to Fuzhou
no more than twice
in my lifetime.

zh: 第一次是一九一一年，是在冬季。
en: I made the first trip in the winter of 1911.

zh: 从严冷枯黄的北方归来，看到展现在我眼前的青山碧水，红花绿叶，使我惊讶而欢喜！
en:
Returned from the bitter cold North
with its drab and dried up vegetation,
I was amazed and delighted
when greeted by the charming scenery of
sapphire mountains and emerald rivers
as well as red flowers and green leaves.

zh: 我觉得我的生命的风帆，已从蔚蓝的海，驶进了碧绿的江。
en:
I felt the sailing boat of my life
steering its way into the green River
after leaving the blue sea behind.

zh: 这天我们在闽江口从大船下到小船，驶到大桥头，来接我们的伯父堂兄们把我们包围了起来，他们用乡音和我的父母热烈地交谈。
en:
At the Minjiang River,
we changed from
the big ship to a small boat,
which took us to Daqiaotou (Big Bridge),
where we were met by Uncle and cousins
They gathered round us
and talked warmly with my parents
in the local dialect.

zh: 我的五岁的大弟弟悄悄地用山东话问我说：
en:
Thereupon,
my 5-year-old younger brother
whispered in my ear
with a Shandong accent,
"How come they can
all speak the Fuzhou dialect?"

zh: 因为从来在我们姐弟心里，福州话是最难懂难说的！
en:
We had both thought that
the Fuzhou dialect
was indeed most difficult
for anyone to learn.

zh: 这以后的一年多时间里，我们就过起了福州城市的生活。
en:
From then on,
we lived an urban life
for more than a year
in Fuzhou.

zh: 新年、元宵、端午、中秋……岁时节日，吃的玩的都是十分丰富而有趣。
en:
During such festivals as
Lunar New Year, Lantern,
Dragon Boat and Mid-Autumn,
we all celebrated the festivities
with plenty of food and fun.

zh: 特别是灯节，那时我们家住在南后街，那里是灯市的街，元宵前后，“花市灯如昼”，灯影下人流潮涌，那光明绚丽的情景就说不尽了。
en:
Particular mention, however,
should be made of the Lantern Festival
when Nanhoujie,
the street known for its lantern fair
and also the street where we lived,
became as bright as
broad daylight at night
with myriads of lanterns
and streams of spectators.
The splendor and magnificence
of the scene is beyond all description.

zh: 第二次回去，是在一九五六年，也是在冬季。
en: I made the second visit in 1956, also in winter.

zh: 那时还没有鹰厦铁路，我们人大代表团是从江西坐汽车进去的。
en:
As the Yingtan-Xiamen Railway
had not yet been built,
the NPC delegation,
with myself as a member,
had to go from Jiangxi Province by car.

zh: 一路上红土公路，道滑如拭，我还没有看见过土铺的公路，维修得这样平整的！
en:
The highway from Jiangxi to Fuzhou,
paved with red soil,
was as smooth as a mirror.
It was the most level
soil-paved highway I had ever seen.

zh: 这次我不但到了福州，还到了漳州、泉州、厦门、鼓浪屿……那是祖国的南疆了。
en:
This time I visited not only Fuzhou,
but also Zhangzhou, Quanzhou,
Xiamen and Gulangyu
-the southern frontiers of our country.

zh: 在厦门前线，我还从望远镜里看见了金门岛上的行人和牛，看得很清楚……
en:
At the Xiamen seaside,
I could see clearly
through a telescope
pedestrians and cows on the Quemoy Islands.

zh: 回忆中的情景很多，在此就不一一描写了。总之，我很喜欢我的父母之乡。
en:
My experiences of this trip,however,
are too numerous to be
recounted one by one here.
Anyway, I deeply love Fuzhou,
my ancestral home.

zh: 那边是南国风光，山是青的，水是绿的，小溪流更是清可见底！
en:
Over there we have
the typical southern scenery
with blue mountains,
green waters,limpid brooks...!

zh: 院里四季都有花开，
en:
There in the courtyard
we can always see
some kind of flowers
in full bloom throughout the year.

zh: 水果是从枇杷、荔枝、龙眼，一直吃到福桔！
en:
Fruits ranging from
loquats, lichees, longans to tangerines
are in plenty.

zh: 对一个孩子来说，还有什么比这个更惬意的呢？
en:
Is there anything more palatable
to a little child than these fruits?

zh: 我在故乡走的地方不多，但古迹、侨乡，到处可见，福建华侨，遍于天下。
en:
I did not visit
all the local attractions in Fuzhou.
Everywhere we could find historical relics
as well as villages and towns
inhabited by relatives of overseas Chinese.
Fujianese expatriates
are found all over the world.

zh: 我所到过的亚、非、欧、美各国都见到辛苦创业的福建侨民，握手之余，情溢言表。
en:
They have mostly started from scratch
by the sweat of their brow.
When I met some of them on my visits
to Asian, African,
European and American couhtries,
they all expressed warm feeling towards me
while shaking my hands.

zh: 在他们家里、（+或者）店里，吃着福州菜，喝着茉莉花茶，使我觉得作为一个福建人是四海都有家的。
en:
As I ate Fuzhou food and sipped jasmine tea
in their homes or shops,
I felt that being a Fujianese,
I could make myself at home
wherever I travelled in the world.

zh: 我的父母之乡是可爱的。
en: My ancestral home is so endearing.

zh: 有人从故乡来，或是有朋友新近到福建去过，我都向他们问起福建的近况。
en:
Whenever I meet somebody
hailing from Fuzhou
or a friend
who has recently been there,
I always inquire of them about
the present conditions of Fujian.

zh: 他们说：福建比起二十多年前来，进步得不可辨认了。
en:
They all tell me that
compared with two decades ago,
Fujian has made so much progress
that it is now almost beyond recognition.

zh: 最近呢，农业科学化了，又在植树造林，山岭田地更加郁郁葱葱了。
en:
Recently I have learned that
people there have gone in for
scientific farming and afforestation
so that green and luxuriant vegetation.
has appeared on
all mountains and fields.

zh: 他们都动员我回去看看，我又何尝不想呢？
en:
People have been advising me
to pay another visit to my old home.
Yes, I am more than eager to do so.

zh: 不但我想，在全世界的天涯海角，更不知有多少人在想！
en:
And so are
my numerous fellow townsmen
in all corners of the world.

zh:
我愿和故乡的人，以及普天下的福建侨民，一同在精神和物质文明方面，(废话
后置）把故乡建设得更美好！(这才是重点，很容易找到）
en:
I hope that
together with all the people
in my home town
as well as all overseas Chinese from Fujian,
I can do my bit to make
a still better place of my ancestral home,
both materially and culturally.

zh: 笼里养着两只母鸡，一只爱唱，另一只喜静。
en:
There were two hens in a coop.
One was fond of cackling
while the other liked to keep quiet.

zh: 主人根据母鸡下蛋之后报唱的现象，以为所有的蛋都是那只唱鸡产的，
en:
As it is customary for a hen
to cackle after laying an egg,
the chicken raiser accordingly credited
the cackler with all the eggs
that had been laid.

zh: 因此很偏爱它，捉得蜂螂也专喂给它吃。
en:
As a result,
he became so partial to his favourite bird
that he fed her with
every cockroach he caught.

zh: 但日子一久，秘密揭穿了：原来那只唱鸡下蛋很少，而不叫的那只却一天一个，
en:
With the passing of time,
however,
it became known that
the cackler had in fact
laid very few eggs
while the non-cackler
kept laying one egg a day.

zh: 且蛋刚落地就一声不响地离开鸡窝，由那只唱鸡站在蛋边大喊大叫。
en:
Every time,
as soon as the latter laid an egg,
she quit the coop quietly,
leaving the former standing by
the newly-laid egg
shouting and yelling her head off.

zh: 闲聊时和朋友谈及此事，他以为我是言外之意不在鸡，而是论人。
en:
Once, when I chatted with
a friend about this,
he thought what I had in mind
was not the hen,
but men in general.

zh:
《尚书·牧誓》里就有“牝鸡无晨”之句。
其实，古人早就以鸡喻人了，
en:
As a matter off act,
our forefathers long ago
already drew an analogy
between the hen and a human,
as witness the Chinese idiom
"No hen crows at dawn"
(meaning"No woman is to
usurp man's power")
in The Book of History: Mu Shi.

zh: 说到人，在我们中确是有很多沉默寡言的人，他们牢牢蹲在自己的岗位上，夜以继日，埋头苦干替国家创造了大量的物质财富，为人民作出了一项又一项的优异成绩。
en:
It is true that
there are among us many
who stick to their posts
and quietly immerse themselves
in hard work day and night,
creating enormous material wealth
for the state
and achieving one success after another
for the people.

zh: 他们像母鸡一样，吞的是粗糠老菜，产下的是蛋，而且往往一声不响。
en:
Like the above-mentioned good layer,
they eat simple food, but lay eggs,
often without making a fanfare.

zh: 但也有一种人，嘴尖舌长，能说会道，自我吹嘘，滔滔不绝，像那只爱唱的母鸡一样，占着个鸡窝不下蛋。
en:
There are among us, however,
another kind of people who,
armed with a glib tongue,
indulge in incessant self-glorification and,
like the above-mentioned cackler,
hold on to the coop without laying any egg.

zh: 个别恶劣的还窃取别人的成果去报喜称功，一点不觉得惭愧。
en:
Some few even go so far as to
brazenly claim credit for work
that was done by others.

zh:
本来，考核一个人的成绩，
不是听他唱得好听不好听，而是看他“下蛋不下蛋”。
en:
The proper way to evaluate a person
is of course by watching
whether or not he "lays eggs"
not by listening to him
singing his own praises.

zh: 但那善于炫耀和卖弄的人，生一个蛋就唱得像是生了十个似的，
en:
When a braggart lays one egg,
he will talk in such a way
as if he had laid ten eggs.

zh: 只做出三分成绩就吹成十分，
en:
When he puts in a tiny bit of work,
he will talk as if
he had done ten times as much.

zh: 碰上个凡事只用耳朵听不用眼睛看的糊涂长官，
en:
He will naturally find favour
with a muddle-headed boss
who trusts his ears more than his eyes.

zh: 自然就博得了偏爱，于是一帆风顺，扶摇直上了。
en:
The braggart
will thus find himself
quickly climbing up the social ladder.

zh: 而那些埋头“下蛋”的人，由于他们一声不响，默默无闻，就很少为人所知，更不受重视。
en:
As to those engrossed in "laying eggs",
because they are reserved
and content to live in obscurity
they gain little public attention,
let alone recognition.

zh: 因此，他们既没有“蜂螂”可吃，甚至连个“下蛋的窝”也没有。
en:
They are given no"cockroaches"to eat.
They do not even have
a "shelter for egg laying".

zh: 喜唱或是爱静，本来只是人的一种个性，
en:
It is in one's nature
to be either noisy or quiet.

zh: 由于是长期养成的习惯，要完全改过来也颇不容易，
en:
As something ingrained,
it cannot be
completely changed overnight.

zh: 但是，在新长征的途程中，人的生命到底有限，而探索宇宙奥秘的道路却又那样的无限和悠长，
en:
But life is short
while the probe into
the mysteries of the universe
is long and unlimited.

zh: 结果一天到晚都用于高谈阔论，搞“假、大、空”，又哪有时间及精力去钻研和攻关呢？
en:
If we indulge in empty talk and trickery day and night,
how can we have time and energy for serious study
and tackling key problems confronting the country
on its new Long March towards modernization?

zh: 最重要的还是认真蹲在“窝”里，多为九亿人民“下蛋”。
en:
The most important thing is to
stand fast to the "coop"
and "lay"more"eggs"
for this nation of 900,000,000 people.

zh: 白杨树实在是不平凡的，我赞美白杨树！
en:
The white poplar is no ordinary tree.
Let me sing its praises.

zh:
当汽车在望不到边际的高原上奔驰，
扑入你的视野的，是黄绿错综的一条大毡子；
en:
When you travel by car
through Northwest China's boundless plateau,
all you see before you is something like
a huge yellow-and-green felt blanket.

zh: 黄的，那是土，未开垦的处女土，几十万年前/由伟大的自然力/所堆积成功的/黄土高原的外壳；
en:
Yellow is the soil-the uncultivated virgin soil.
It is the outer covering of the loess plateau
accumulated by Mother Nature
several hundred thousand years ago.

zh: 绿的呢，是人类战胜自然的结果，是麦田，和风吹送，翻起了一轮一轮的绿波
en:
Green are the wheat fields
signifying man's triumph over nature.
They become a sea of rolling green waves
whenever there is a soft breeze.

zh: ——这时你会真心佩服昔人所造的两个字“麦浪”，若不是妙手偶得，便确是经过锤炼的语言的精华；
en:
One is here
reminded of Chinese expression mai lang
meaning "rippling wheat"
and cannot help admiring
our forefathers'ingenuity in
coining such a happy phrase.
It must have been
either the brainwave of a clever scholar,
or a linguistic gem sanctioned
by long usage.

zh:
黄与绿主宰着，无边无堪，坦荡如砥，
这时如果不是宛若并肩的远山的连峰提醒了你（这些山峰凭你的肉眼来判断，就知道是在你脚底下的）,你会忘记了汽车是在高原上行驶。
en:
The boundless highland,
with dominant yellow and green,
is flat like a whetstone.
Were it not for distant mountain peaks
standing side by side
(which, as your naked eyes tell you,
are below where you stand),
you would probably forget
that you are on the highland.

zh: 这时你涌起来的感想也许是“雄壮”，也许是“伟大”，诸如此类的形容词；
en:
The sight of the scene
will probably call up inside you
a string of epithets like
"spectacular"or"grand".

zh: 然而同时你的眼睛也许觉得有点倦怠，你对当前的“雄壮”或“伟大”闭了眼，而另一种味儿在你的心头潜滋暗长了——“单调”！
en:
Meanwhile, however,
your eyes may become weary of
watching the same panorama,
so much so that you are oblivious of
its being spectacular or grand.
And you may feel monotony coming on.
Yes,it is somewhat monotonous,isn't it?

zh:
然而刹那间，要是你猛抬眼看见了前面远远地有一排，
—不，或者甚至只是三五株，一二株，傲然地耸立，像哨兵似的树木的话，那你的恢恢欲睡的情绪又将如何？我那时是惊奇地叫了一声的！
en:
Now what will become of your weariness
if you suddenly raise your eyes
only to catch sight of distant row of trees
(or just a couple of them)
standing there proudly like sentries.
For my part,
I cannot keep from uttering
an exclamation of surprise!

zh: 那就是白杨树，西北极普通的一种树，然而实在不是平凡的一种树！
en:
They are white poplars.
Though very common in Northwest China,
they are no ordinary trees!

zh: 那是一种力争上游的一种树，笔直的干，笔直的枝。
en:
With straight trunks and branches,
white poplars aim high.

zh: 它的干呢，通常是丈把高，像是加过人工似的，一丈以内，绝无旁枝；
en:
Their trunks are usually over ten feet tall and,
as if wrought by human effort,
utterly bare of branches below ten feet.

zh: 它所有的丫枝呢，一律向上，而且紧紧靠拢，也像是加过人工似的，成为一束，绝无横斜逸出；
en:
Their twigs,
also like things artificially shaped,
all reach out towards the sky
and grow close together in a cluster
without any sideway growth

zh: 它的宽大的叶子也是片片向上，几乎没有斜生的，更不用说倒垂了；
en:
Their leaves are broad
and point upwards
with very few slanting sideways,
much less upside down.

zh: 它的皮，光滑而有银色的晕圈，微微泛出淡青色。
en:
Their glossy barks
are a faint light green
with hazy silver spots. with

zh: 这是虽在北方的风雪的压迫下却保持着倔强挺立的一种树！
en:
They stand erect and unbending
in face of
North China's violent wind and snow.

zh: 哪怕只有碗来精细罢，它却努力向上发展，高到丈许，二丈，参天耸立，不折不挠，对抗着西北风。
en:
Though they maybe only
as big as the mouth of bowl,
they strive to grow upwards
until they reach
the towering height of some twenty feet
and stand indomitable
against the northwest wind.

zh: 这就是白杨树，西北极普通的一种树，然而决不是平凡的树！
en:
They are white poplars.
Though very common in Northwest China
they are no ordinary trees!

zh: 它没有婆婆的姿态，没有屈曲盘旋的虹枝，也许你要说它不美丽，——如果美是专指“婆婆”或“横斜逸出”之类而言，那么白杨树算不得树中的好女子。
en:
You may call them unattractive.
because they have neither
the graceful carriage of a dancer,
nor such branches
as can twine and climb.

zh: 但是它却是伟岸，正直，朴质，严肃，也不缺乏温和，更不用提它的坚强不屈与挺拔，它是树中伟丈夫！
en:
But nevertheless they are big and tall,
honest and upright,
simple and plain,
earnest and unyielding
——and not without
gentleness and warmth though.
They are giants among trees!

zh: 当你在积雪初融的高原上走过，看见平坦的大地上傲然挺立这么一株或一排白杨树，难道你觉得树只是树？
en:
When you trudge through
the melting snow of the highland
and see one or a row of white poplars
standing proudly on the vast plains,
how could you look upon them
as nothing but mere trees?

zh: 难道你就想不到它的朴质，严肃，坚强不屈，至少也象征了北方的农民？
en:
How could you forget that
with all their simplicity,
earnestness and unyieldingness,
they are symbolic of our peasants
in the North?

zh:
难道你竟一点也不联想到，在敌后的广大土地上，到处有坚强不屈，就像这白
杨树一样傲然挺立的守卫他们家乡的哨兵？
en:
How could you fail to
associate them with our dauntless soldiers
guarding our homeland
all over the vast rear?

zh:
难道你又不更远一点想到这样枝枝叶叶靠紧团结，力求上进的白杨树，
宛然象征了今天在华北平原纵横激荡，
用血写出新中国历史的那种精神和意志。
en:
How could you fail to
see that these trees,
ever striving to
put out their closely knit branches
and leaves in an upward direction,
are symbolic of
the spirit and will of our men who
,fighting heroically
all over the northern plains,
are writing the history of New China
with their own blood?

zh: 白杨不是平凡的树。
en: White poplars are no ordinary trees.

zh: 它是西北极普遍，不被人重视，就跟北方农民相似；
en:
But these common trees
in Northwest China
are as much ignored as
our peasants in the North.

zh: 它有极强的生命力，磨折不了，压迫不倒，也跟北方的农民相似。
en:
However, like our peasants in the North,
they are bursting with vitality
and capable of surviving
any hardship or oppression.

zh: 我赞美白杨树，就因为它不但象征了北方的农民，尤其象征了今天我们民族解放斗争中所不可缺的朴质，坚强，以及力求上进的精神。
en:
I pay tribute to them
because they symbolize our peasants in the North and,
in particular, the spirit of honesty, tenacity and forging ahead—a spirit central to our struggle for national liberation.

zh: 让那些看不起民众，贱视民众，顽固的倒退的人们去赞美那贵族化的楠木（那也是直干秀顾的）,去鄙视这极常见、极易生长的白杨罢，我要高声赞美白杨树！
en:
The reactionary diehards,
who despise and snub the common people,
can do whatever they like
to eulogize the elite nanmu
(which is also tall, straight and good-looking)
and look down upon the common,
fast-growing white poplar.
I, for my part,
will be loud in my praise of the latter!

zh: 没有在浮沉的人海中，翻过筋斗的和尚，不能算善知识；
en:
A Buddhist monk
without having experienced
ups and downs in the sea of mortals
will have no claim to true wisdom.

zh: 没有受过恋爱洗礼的人生，不能算真人生。
en:
Likewise,
one who has never gone through
the baptism of romantic love
will have little genuine knowledge of life.

zh: 和尚最大的努力，是否认现世而求未来的涅槃，
en:
Buddhist monks exert every effort
to renounce this life
in favour of future nirvana.

zh: 但他若不曾了解现世，
en: But, without a full knowledge of this life,

zh: 他又怎能勘破现世，
en:
how could they see through
the vanity of human society

zh: 而跳出三界外呢？
en:
and make a clean break
with this mortal world?

zh: 而恋爱是人类生活的中心，孟子说：“食色性也。”
en:
Romantic love is the core of human life.
Mencius says,
"The desire for food and sex is nature."

zh: 所谓恋爱正是天赋之本能；
en:
In other words,
love is innate.

zh: 如一生不了解恋爱的人，他又何能了解整个人生？
en:
If one remains a life long stranger to love,
how can he thoroughly understand life?

zh: 所以凡事都从学习而知而能，
en: Man becomes capable through learning.

zh: 只有恋爱用不着学习，只要到了相当的年龄，碰到合式（适）的机会，他和她便会莫名其妙地恋爱起来。
en:
But love is an exception.
Boy and girl, when they are of age
and meet at an opportune moment,
will become mysteriously attached to each other.

zh: 恋爱人人都会，可是不见得人人都懂，
en:
Though people love by instinct,
yet all cannot understand it correctly.

zh: 世俗大半以性欲伪充恋爱，以游戏的态度处置恋爱，
en:
More often than not,
love is but carnal desire in disguise
and is treated as a mere game.

zh: 于是我们时刻可看到因恋爱而不幸的记载。
en:
That is why
we so often hear
tragic stories of love.

zh: 实在的恋爱绝不是游戏，也绝不是堕落的人生所能体验出其价值的，
en:
True love is not a game.
Nor can its true value
be appreciated by
the morally degenerate.

zh: 它具有引人向上的鞭策力，它也具有伟大无私的至上情操，它更是美丽的象征。
en:
True love spurs one
on to higher attainment.
It embodies
the supreme quality of selflessness,
and is, above all, symbolic of beauty.

zh: 在一双男女正纯洁热爱着的时候，他和她内心充实着惊人的力量；
en:
When a man and woman
are deeply immersed in true love,
they are full of amazing inner strength.

zh: 他们的灵魂是从万有的束缚中，得到了自由，
en: Their souls are freed from all bondage.

zh: 不怕威胁，不为利诱，他们是超越了现实，而创造他们理想的乐园。
en:
They are unyielding before threats
and incorruptible before
any promise of material gain.
They transcend the reality
to create an ideal paradise of their own.

zh: 不幸物欲充塞的现世界，这种恋爱的光辉，有如萤火之微弱，
en:
Unfortunately,
in this present world
overflowing with material desires,
this kind of true love is
as rare as the feeble light of fireflies.

zh: 而且“恋爱”有时适成为无知男女堕落之阶，
en:
What is more,
"love" sometimes even leads to
moral degeneration
on the part of ignorant men and women.

zh: 使维纳斯不禁深深地叹息：“自从世界人群趋向灭亡之途，恋爱变成了游戏，哀哉！”
en:
Over this, Venus cannot help
lamenting with a deep sigh,
" Love has become a mere game
ever since humanity set out
on its way to extinction.
O what a sad story!"

zh: 在郭老新编的话剧“蔡文姬”里，提到了蔡文姬的父亲蔡邕（yong)所造的那张焦尾琴。
en:
In the play Cai Wenji,
newly written by venerable Guo Moruo,
reference is made to jiao wen qin,
a zithern partly made of scorched wood
by Cai Yong, father of Cai Wenji.

zh: 最近我看了“蔡文姬”的演出，自然而然想起了焦尾琴，想起了关于焦尾琴的故事：
en:
Recently,
after I saw the play on the stage,
my mind naturally went to
jiao wen qin and its story.

zh: 蔡邕因为不愿趋附权贵，怕被人陷害，曾经亡命江南，往来于吴会之间（今江、浙一带）,计十二年。
en:
Cai Yong disliked playing up to bigwigs and,
to avoid frame-ups,
he went into exile in the South,
wandering about for twelve years
in Jiangsu and Zhejiang Provinces.

zh: 据说他在吴（今苏州）的时候，有一天听见邻家烧饭的柴火中发出一种爆裂的声音，他熟悉这种声音，知道这声音来自一种极好的桐木，这种桐木是造琴的最好材料。
en:
It is said that one day during his stay in Suzhou
when he heard the crackling of firewood
from his next-door neighbour at cooking time,
he knew the familiar sound
came from paulownia,
a kind of choice wood best for making zitherns.

zh: 他就跟邻家主人商量，把这段烧焦了的桐木要了来，造成一张琴。
en:
Now, talking it over with his neighbour,
he was given the piece of scorched wood,
which he subsequently made into a zithern.

zh: 这张琴弹起来果然非常好听。
en:
This musical instrument,
when played,
turned out to be
extremely pleasant to the ear.

zh: 因为它的一端是烧焦的，所以大家都叫它焦尾琴。
en:
People called it jiao wei qin
because the tail of its sound-board
was made of scorched wood.

zh: 使我对“耳闻不如目见”这句成语不能不有所怀疑。
en:
I cannot help having doubts about
the validity of the proverb,
"Seeing is better than hearing."

zh:
的确，我们认识这个物质世界，
有时候不是用眼睛来看而是用耳朵来听的。
en:
Fact is, to know the material world,
we sometimes use not the eye, but the ear.

zh: 蔡岂能够从木材燃烧时发出的爆裂声来辨别木材的好坏，充分说明了“耳闻”不一定“不如目见”。
en:
That Cai Yong could tell
the quality of wood
by listening to its crackling sound
while it was burning in the kitchen stove
makes it crystal clear that
"hearing" is not necessarily
less reliable than "seeing".

zh: 当然，“耳闻不如目见”这句话的原意是指间接经验不如直接经验那样可靠，这是完全正确的。
en:
The above-mentioned proverb
literally means that
secondhand experience
is less reliable than firsthand experience,
which is perfectly true.

zh: 但是，如果对这句话只是从字面上来理解，认为耳朵听到的总不如眼睛看见的那样可靠，那对耳朵来说，却是极大的冤枉。
en:
But, if we should take this saying
at its face value
and regard the ear as
invariably less reliable than the eye,
